Ab Scissors.instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and hands under your glutes for support. Lift both legs a few inches off the floor and cross them over each other in a scissor-like motion, alternating which leg is on top. Keep your lower back pressed into the floor throughout the movement.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands tucked under your glutes.
Lift both legs a few inches off the ground, keeping them straight.
Cross one leg over the other in a scissor motion, then switch.
Keep your core braced and lower back flat on the floor throughout.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.

Ab Wheel.instructions: Kneel on the floor holding an ab wheel with both hands directly under your shoulders. Slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your body as far as you can while keeping your core braced and back flat, then use your abs to pull the wheel back to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Kneel on a mat and grip the ab wheel handles with both hands.
Position the wheel on the floor directly under your shoulders.
Brace your core and slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your body.
Go as far as you can control without letting your hips sag.
Reverse the motion and pull the wheel back to the starting position.

Bicycle Crunch.instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and knees bent. Bring one knee toward your chest while rotating your torso to touch the opposite elbow to that knee, then switch sides in a pedaling motion, keeping your core engaged throughout.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with hands lightly behind your head and knees bent.
Lift your shoulder blades off the floor and bring one knee toward your chest.
Rotate your torso to bring the opposite elbow toward that knee.
Extend the other leg out straight as you twist.
Alternate sides in a continuous pedaling motion for the desired reps.

Bicycle Crunch Raised Legs.instructions: Lie on your back with both legs raised toward the ceiling and hands behind your head. Perform the bicycle crunch motion by rotating your torso and bringing each elbow toward the opposite knee while keeping the non-working leg extended upward, increasing the challenge on the lower abs.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back and raise both legs toward the ceiling.
Place your hands lightly behind your head and lift your shoulder blades off the floor.
Bend one knee toward your chest while rotating to touch it with the opposite elbow.
Keep the other leg extended upward rather than lowering it.
Alternate sides continuously for the desired number of repetitions.

Cable Core Palloff Press.instructions: Stand sideways to a cable machine set at chest height, holding the handle with both hands at your sternum. Press the handle straight out in front of you, resisting the cable's pull to rotate your torso, then return to your chest and repeat.
instruction_steps: Set the cable pulley to chest height and stand sideways to the machine.
Grip the handle with both hands and hold it at your sternum.
Step away from the machine to create tension in the cable.
Press the handle straight out in front of your chest without letting your torso rotate.
Hold briefly, then return the handle to your chest and repeat before switching sides.

Cable Crunch.instructions: Kneel below a high cable pulley holding a rope attachment beside your head. Flex your spine and crunch your torso down toward your thighs, contracting your abs, then slowly return to the upright starting position.
instruction_steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel a couple feet in front of it.
Hold the rope ends beside your head with elbows pointing forward.
Brace your abs and crunch your torso down, rounding your spine toward your thighs.
Pause briefly at the bottom, squeezing your abs.
Slowly rise back to the starting position and repeat.

Cable Twist (Down to up).instructions: Stand sideways to a low cable pulley holding the handle with both hands near your hip. Rotate and pull the handle diagonally upward across your body to shoulder height, pivoting your feet slightly, then return under control.
instruction_steps: Set the pulley to a low position and stand sideways to the machine.
Grip the handle with both hands near your outside hip.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally up and across your body.
Finish with your arms extended near the opposite shoulder.
Return slowly to the starting position and repeat, then switch sides.

Cable Twist (Up to down).instructions: Stand sideways to a high cable pulley holding the handle with both hands near your shoulder. Rotate and pull the handle diagonally downward across your body toward your opposite hip, then return under control.
instruction_steps: Set the pulley to a high position and stand sideways to the machine.
Grip the handle with both hands near your outside shoulder.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally down and across your body.
Finish with your arms extended near the opposite hip.
Return slowly to the starting position and repeat, then switch sides.

Crunch.instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your hands lightly behind your head or crossed over your chest, then curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor by contracting your abs, before lowering back down with control.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head or crossed over your chest.
Contract your abs to curl your shoulder blades off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top, avoiding pulling on your neck.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Crunch (Machine).instructions: Sit in the crunch machine with your feet secured and hands gripping the handles or pads. Flex your torso forward against the resistance, contracting your abs, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Adjust the machine seat and select an appropriate weight.
Sit down and secure your feet, gripping the handles or chest pads.
Contract your abs to curl your torso forward against the resistance.
Pause briefly at full contraction.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Crunch (Weighted).instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest. Curl your shoulders off the floor by contracting your abs, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell securely against your chest.
Contract your abs to curl your shoulder blades off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Dead Bug.instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended towards the ceiling. Bend your knees and lift your legs off the ground, creating a 90-degree angle at your hips and knees. Engage your core and lower back to press your lower back into the ground. Slowly lower your right arm and left leg towards the ground, keeping them straight and hovering just above the floor. Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position. Repeat the movement with your left arm and right leg. Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended towards the ceiling.
Bend your knees and lift your legs off the ground, creating a 90-degree angle at your hips and knees.
Engage your core and lower back to press your lower back into the ground.
Slowly lower your right arm and left leg towards the ground, keeping them straight and hovering just above the floor.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left arm and right leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

Decline Crunch.instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle. Place your hands behind your head or across your chest. Engage your abs and lift your upper body towards your knees, curling your torso. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body towards your knees, curling your torso.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Decline Crunch (Weighted).instructions: Secure your feet on a decline bench and hold a weight plate against your chest. Curl your torso up toward your knees by contracting your abs, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Set up on a decline bench with feet secured under the pads.
Hold a weight plate against your chest and lie back.
Contract your abs to curl your torso up toward your thighs.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Dragon Flag.instructions: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head for stability. Raise your legs and torso off the bench, keeping your body straight, so only your upper back and shoulders remain in contact, then slowly lower your body back down without letting your hips sag.
instruction_steps: Lie on a flat bench and grip the edge behind your head.
Brace your core and lift your legs and hips off the bench.
Raise your entire body into a straight line, balancing on your upper back.
Hold briefly at the top, keeping your body rigid.
Lower your body slowly and with control back to the bench.

Dragonfly.instructions: Lie on a bench gripping it behind your head, similar to the dragon flag, but keep your torso stationary while raising and lowering only your legs and hips as a straight unit, minimizing hip flexion.
instruction_steps: Lie on a flat bench and grip the edge behind your head.
Keep your upper back pressed to the bench and legs extended.
Brace your core and raise your straight legs and hips upward.
Slowly lower your legs back down without touching the bench.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, keeping the torso still.

Elbow to Knee.instructions: Stand or lie down and bring your elbow toward the opposite raised knee, rotating your torso to engage your obliques, then return and repeat on the other side in a controlled, rhythmic motion.
instruction_steps: Stand tall or lie on your back depending on the variation.
Raise one knee toward your chest.
Rotate your torso and bring the opposite elbow toward that knee.
Return to the starting position with control.
Repeat, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

Flutter Kicks.instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your hands by your sides. Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground about 6 inches. Keeping your legs straight, alternate lifting one leg slightly higher than the other. Continue this fluttering motion for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your hands by your sides.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground about 6 inches.
Keeping your legs straight, alternate lifting one leg slightly higher than the other.
Continue this fluttering motion for the desired number of repetitions.

Hanging Knee Raise.instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms fully extended and shoulders engaged. Bend your knees and raise them toward your chest by contracting your abs, then lower them back down with control without swinging.
instruction_steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms fully extended.
Engage your shoulders and brace your core.
Bend your knees and raise them toward your chest.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your legs back down with control and repeat.

Hanging Leg Raise.instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you. Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight. Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or as high as you can comfortably go. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or as high as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Heel Taps.instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Curl your shoulders slightly off the floor and reach one hand down to tap the corresponding heel, then alternate sides in a controlled, side-to-side crunching motion.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Lift your shoulder blades slightly off the floor.
Reach one hand down to tap your heel on that side.
Return to center and reach the other hand to the opposite heel.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

Hollow Rock.instructions: Lie on your back and press your lower back into the floor, extending your arms overhead and legs straight while lifting your shoulders and legs off the ground into a hollow body shape. Rock gently back and forth while maintaining this position.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your core.
Lift your shoulders, arms, and legs slightly off the ground.
Rock your body gently forward and backward while holding the hollow position.
Continue for the desired duration, keeping your lower back flat.

Jack Knife (Suspension).instructions: Place your feet in suspension trainer straps and get into a plank position with hands under your shoulders. Pike your hips up and pull your knees toward your chest, then extend your legs back out to the plank position.
instruction_steps: Place your feet in the suspension straps and assume a plank position.
Brace your core with hands directly under your shoulders.
Pull your knees toward your chest, piking your hips upward.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Extend your legs back out to the plank position and repeat.

Jackknife Sit Up.instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended overhead and legs straight. Simultaneously lift your torso and legs, reaching your hands toward your toes to form a V-shape, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on your back with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Simultaneously raise your torso and legs off the floor.
Reach your hands toward your toes as your body forms a V-shape.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your torso and legs back down together with control.

Knee Raise Parallel Bars.instructions: Support your body on parallel bars or a captain's chair with your torso upright. Bend your knees and raise them toward your chest by contracting your abs, then lower them back down with control.
instruction_steps: Support your bodyweight on the parallel bars with arms straight.
Keep your torso upright and braced.
Bend your knees and raise them toward your chest.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your legs back down with control and repeat.

L-Sit Hold.instructions: Support your body on parallel bars, blocks, or the floor with your arms straight. Raise your legs out in front of you until they are parallel to the ground, forming an L-shape with your body, and hold this position while keeping your core braced.
instruction_steps: Place your hands on parallel bars or the floor beside your hips.
Press down through your hands to lift your body off the surface.
Extend both legs straight out in front of you, parallel to the floor.
Keep your shoulders depressed and core braced.
Hold the position for the desired duration.

Landmine 180.instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell with both hands in front of your chest. Bend your knees slightly and rotate your torso to the right, swinging the barbell down towards your right hip. As you reach the bottom of the movement, quickly reverse the motion and rotate your torso to the left, swinging the barbell up and across your body towards your left shoulder. Continue this twisting motion, alternating sides, for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell with both hands in front of your chest.
Bend your knees slightly and rotate your torso to the right, swinging the barbell down towards your right hip.
As you reach the bottom of the movement, quickly reverse the motion and rotate your torso to the left, swinging the barbell up and across your body towards your left shoulder.
Continue this twisting motion, alternating sides, for the desired number of repetitions.

Leg Raise Parallel Bars.instructions: Support your body on parallel bars with your arms straight and torso upright. Keeping your legs straight, raise them in front of you as high as you can by contracting your lower abs, then lower them back down with control.
instruction_steps: Support your bodyweight on the parallel bars with arms straight.
Keep your torso upright and avoid swinging.
Raise your straight legs in front of you as high as comfortable.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your legs back down with control and repeat.

Lying Knee Raise.instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and hands under your glutes for support. Bend your knees and draw them toward your chest by contracting your lower abs, then lower your legs back down without touching the floor.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands under your glutes.
Bend your knees and draw them toward your chest.
Contract your abs at the top of the movement.
Lower your legs back down slowly without touching the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Lying Leg Raise.instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and hands under your glutes for support. Keeping your legs straight, raise them toward the ceiling by contracting your lower abs, then lower them back down without letting your feet touch the floor.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands under your glutes.
Keep your legs straight and together.
Raise your legs toward the ceiling using your lower abs.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your legs back down slowly without touching the floor.

Oblique Crunch.instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and dropped to one side, hands lightly behind your head. Curl your shoulders up and toward your hips, engaging your obliques, then lower back down with control before switching sides.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and dropped to one side.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Contract your obliques to curl your shoulders up and across.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat, then switch sides.

Plank.instructions: Get into a forearm plank position with your elbows under your shoulders and body forming a straight line from head to heels. Brace your core and glutes, keeping your hips level, and hold the position for the desired duration.
instruction_steps: Place your forearms on the floor with elbows under your shoulders.
Extend your legs back so your body forms a straight line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep your hips level.
Keep your neck neutral, looking at the floor.
Hold the position for the desired duration.

Reverse Crunch.instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended along your sides. Bend your knees and lift your feet off the ground, bringing your thighs perpendicular to the floor. Contract your abs and curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees towards your chest. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended along your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the ground, bringing your thighs perpendicular to the floor.
Contract your abs and curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Reverse Plank.instructions: Sit with your legs extended and hands placed slightly behind your hips, fingers pointing forward. Push through your hands and heels to lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from head to heels, and hold the position.
instruction_steps: Sit on the floor with legs extended and hands behind your hips.
Point your fingers forward and press your palms into the floor.
Push through your hands and heels to lift your hips upward.
Form a straight line from your head to your heels.
Hold the position for the desired duration.

Russian Twist (Bodyweight).instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back slightly, keeping your torso straight and core braced. Lift your feet off the floor if possible, then rotate your torso side to side, touching the floor beside your hips.
instruction_steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet flat or lifted.
Lean back slightly to a 45-degree angle, keeping your back straight.
Clasp your hands together in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side, then the other, in a controlled twist.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

Russian Twist (Weighted).instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, holding a weight plate or dumbbell with both hands. Lean back slightly, keeping your torso straight and core braced, then rotate side to side, tapping the weight near the floor beside your hips.
instruction_steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent and hold a weight with both hands.
Lean back slightly to a 45-degree angle, keeping your back straight.
Lift your feet off the floor if you can maintain balance.
Rotate your torso to one side, then the other, moving the weight across your body.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

Side Bend.instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms at your sides. Bend directly sideways at the waist as far as comfortable, then return to upright and repeat on the other side, keeping your torso facing forward throughout.
instruction_steps: Stand upright with feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your arms relaxed at your sides.
Bend directly sideways at the waist, sliding one hand down your leg.
Return to the upright starting position.
Repeat on the other side for the desired number of repetitions.

Side Bend (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side, with your other hand on your hip or behind your head. Bend sideways toward the dumbbell as far as comfortable, then return to upright, keeping the movement controlled.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Keep your other hand on your hip for support.
Bend sideways toward the weighted side, lowering the dumbbell along your leg.
Return to the upright starting position by contracting your obliques.
Complete all reps on one side, then switch sides.

Side Plank.instructions: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor directly under your shoulder and legs stacked. Lift your hips off the floor to form a straight line from head to feet, and hold this position while keeping your core braced.
instruction_steps: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder.
Stack your feet or stagger them for stability.
Brace your core and lift your hips off the floor.
Form a straight line from your head to your feet.
Hold the position for the desired duration, then switch sides.

Sit Up.instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hands lightly behind your head or crossed over your chest. Curl your entire torso up until you're sitting upright, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Cross your arms over your chest or place hands lightly behind your head.
Contract your abs to curl your torso all the way up to sitting.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Sit Up (Weighted).instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, holding a weight plate against your chest. Curl your entire torso up until you're sitting upright, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a weight plate securely against your chest.
Contract your abs to curl your torso all the way up to sitting.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Spiderman.instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands under your shoulders. Bring one knee up toward the same-side elbow, tapping the floor with your foot if possible, then return and repeat on the other side while keeping your hips low and core braced.
instruction_steps: Start in a high plank position with hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Bring one knee toward the same-side elbow, rotating your hip.
Return your foot to the starting plank position.
Repeat on the other side, alternating for the desired reps.

Toe Touch.instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended straight up toward the ceiling. Reach both hands up to try to touch your toes by curling your shoulders off the floor, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with legs extended straight up toward the ceiling.
Extend your arms toward your feet.
Contract your abs to curl your shoulders off the floor, reaching for your toes.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Toes to Bar.instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms fully extended. Keeping your legs straight, raise them upward until your toes touch the bar, engaging your abs and lats, then lower back down with control without swinging.
instruction_steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms fully extended.
Engage your shoulders and brace your core.
Raise your straight legs upward until your toes touch the bar.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your legs back down with control and repeat.

Torso Rotation.instructions: Sit or stand with your core braced and a light weight or bar across your shoulders if using resistance. Rotate your torso as far as comfortable to one side, then to the other, keeping your hips relatively stable throughout the movement.
instruction_steps: Sit or stand tall with your core engaged.
Hold a bar or weight across your shoulders if adding resistance.
Rotate your torso to one side as far as comfortable.
Return to center, then rotate to the other side.
Continue alternating for the desired number of repetitions.

V Up.instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended overhead and legs straight. Simultaneously lift your torso and legs, reaching your hands toward your toes to form a V-shape, then lower back down together with control.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on your back with arms extended overhead and legs together.
Simultaneously raise your torso and straight legs off the floor.
Reach your hands toward your toes as your body forms a V-shape.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your torso and legs back down together with control.

Hip Abduction (Machine).instructions: Sit in the hip abduction machine with your legs against the pads and knees bent at 90 degrees. Push your legs outward against the resistance, then slowly return to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Adjust the machine and sit with your outer thighs against the pads.
Select an appropriate resistance and grip the side handles.
Push your legs outward against the resistance.
Pause briefly at full abduction.
Slowly return your legs to the starting position and repeat.

Hip Adduction (Machine).instructions: Sit in the hip adduction machine with your legs against the pads positioned apart. Squeeze your legs together against the resistance, then slowly return to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Adjust the machine and sit with your inner thighs against the pads.
Select an appropriate resistance and grip the side handles.
Squeeze your legs together against the resistance.
Pause briefly at full adduction.
Slowly return your legs to the starting position and repeat.

21s Bicep Curl.instructions: Hold a barbell with an underhand grip. Perform 7 partial curls from the bottom to the midpoint, 7 partial curls from the midpoint to the top, then 7 full-range curls, all without resting, to fully fatigue the biceps.
instruction_steps: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Perform 7 curls from the bottom position to the midpoint only.
Immediately perform 7 curls from the midpoint to the fully contracted top position.
Finish with 7 full range-of-motion curls from bottom to top.
Keep your elbows fixed at your sides throughout all three phases.

Behind the Back Curl (Cable).instructions: Stand facing away from a low cable pulley, holding the handle behind your back with an underhand grip. Curl the handle upward and forward, contracting your bicep, then lower it back down with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a handle to a low pulley and stand facing away from the machine.
Hold the handle behind your back with an underhand grip.
Curl the handle upward and forward toward your shoulder.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower the handle back down with control and repeat.

Bicep Curl (Barbell).instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand, shoulder-width grip, arms fully extended. Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders by contracting your biceps, keeping your elbows fixed at your sides, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides throughout the movement.
Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Lower the bar back down with control and repeat.

Bicep Curl (Cable).instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley holding the bar or handle with an underhand grip. Curl the handle upward toward your shoulders, keeping your elbows fixed at your sides, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a bar or handle to a low pulley and stand facing the machine.
Grip the attachment with an underhand grip, arms extended.
Curl the handle upward toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Lower the handle back down with control and repeat.

Bicep Curl (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with palms facing forward. Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders by contracting your biceps, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides throughout the movement.
Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control and repeat.

Bicep Curl (Machine).instructions: Sit in the bicep curl machine with your upper arms resting on the pad and hands gripping the handles. Curl the handles upward against the resistance, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grip the handles with an underhand grip.
Curl the handles upward, contracting your biceps.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Bicep Curl (Suspension).instructions: Hold the suspension trainer handles and lean back with your arms extended, body straight and braced. Curl your body up by bending your elbows and contracting your biceps, then extend back down with control.
instruction_steps: Hold the suspension straps and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight and core braced, feet planted.
Bend your elbows to curl your body upward.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Extend your arms back out with control and repeat.

Concentration Curl.instructions: Sit on a bench with your elbow braced against the inside of your thigh, holding a dumbbell with an underhand grip. Curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Sit on a bench with legs spread and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Brace the back of your upper arm against the inside of your thigh.
Curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your bicep.
Lower the dumbbell back down with control and repeat.

Cross Body Hammer Curl.instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with a neutral grip. Curl one dumbbell diagonally across your body toward the opposite shoulder, then lower back down and repeat with the other arm.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing in.
Keep your elbow pinned to your side.
Curl one dumbbell diagonally up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and alternate arms.

Drag Curl.instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip. Curl the bar upward while dragging it close along your torso and pulling your elbows back, rather than forward, to emphasize the biceps.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Begin the curl by pulling your elbows back rather than forward.
Drag the bar upward, keeping it close to your torso.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower the bar back down along the same path and repeat.

EZ Bar Biceps Curl.instructions: Stand holding an EZ curl bar with an underhand grip on the angled handles. Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders by contracting your biceps, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip on the angled section.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Lower the bar back down with control and repeat.

Hammer Curl (Band).instructions: Stand on a resistance band holding the handles with a neutral grip at your sides. Curl the handles upward toward your shoulders, keeping your palms facing each other, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handles at your sides with a neutral grip.
Curl the handles upward toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Hammer Curl (Cable).instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley holding a rope attachment with a neutral grip. Curl the rope upward toward your shoulders, keeping your palms facing each other, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing the machine.
Grip the rope with a neutral grip, arms extended.
Curl the rope upward toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Hammer Curl (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with palms facing each other. Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders, keeping your palms neutral throughout, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Kettlebell Curl.instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides with an underhand or neutral grip. Curl the kettlebells upward toward your shoulders, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a kettlebell in each hand by the horns.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl the kettlebells upward toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Overhead Curl (Cable).instructions: Stand facing a high cable pulley with a single handle or rope attachment at head height, holding it with both hands. Curl the handle down toward your forehead, feeling the squeeze in your biceps, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a handle to a high pulley and stand facing the machine.
Grip the handle with both hands and hold it at head height, elbows bent.
Curl your hands down toward your forehead, keeping your elbows stationary.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement, feeling the bicep contraction.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

Pinwheel Curl (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip. Curl one dumbbell across your body toward the opposite shoulder while the other rotates outward, alternating in a windmill-like pattern.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip.
Curl one dumbbell diagonally across your body toward your opposite shoulder.
Lower it back down while curling the other dumbbell in the same crossing pattern.
Keep your elbows relatively fixed at your sides.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.

Plate Curl.instructions: Stand holding a weight plate with both hands at the outer edges, arms extended. Curl the plate upward toward your chest by contracting your biceps, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a weight plate with both hands.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl the plate upward toward your chest.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower the plate back down with control and repeat.

Preacher Curl (Barbell).instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the angled pad, holding a barbell with an underhand grip. Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders, then lower back down with control without locking out your elbows abruptly.
instruction_steps: Sit at the preacher bench with your upper arms flat on the pad.
Hold a barbell with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Lower the bar back down with control and repeat.

Preacher Curl (Dumbbell).instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with one arm resting on the angled pad, holding a dumbbell with an underhand grip. Curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Sit at the preacher bench with one upper arm flat on the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with an underhand grip, arm extended.
Curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your bicep.
Lower the dumbbell back down with control and repeat.

Preacher Curl (Machine).instructions: Sit at the preacher curl machine with your upper arms resting on the pad and hands gripping the handles. Curl the handles upward against the resistance, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the pad.
Grip the handles with an underhand grip.
Curl the handles upward, contracting your biceps.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Reverse Curl (Barbell).instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip, arms fully extended. Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders by contracting your forearms and biceps, keeping your wrists straight, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a barbell with an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides and wrists straight.
Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower the bar back down with control and repeat.

Reverse Curl (Cable).instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley holding the bar with an overhand grip. Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders, keeping your wrists straight, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a bar to a low pulley and stand facing the machine.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip, arms extended.
Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Reverse Curl (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with an overhand grip. Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders, keeping your wrists straight, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Reverse Grip Concentration Curl.instructions: Sit on a bench with your elbow braced against the inside of your thigh, holding a dumbbell with an overhand grip. Curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Sit on a bench with legs spread and hold a dumbbell with an overhand grip.
Brace the back of your upper arm against the inside of your thigh.
Curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell back down with control and repeat.

Rope Cable Curl.instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley holding a rope attachment with a neutral grip. Curl the rope upward toward your shoulders, spreading the rope ends apart at the top, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing the machine.
Grip the rope ends with a neutral grip, arms extended.
Curl the rope upward toward your shoulders, separating the ends near the top.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Seated Incline Curl (Dumbbell).instructions: Sit back on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down. Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders, then lower back down with control, letting your arms stretch behind your torso.
instruction_steps: Sit back on an incline bench set to about 45-60 degrees.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down.
Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control, allowing a full stretch, and repeat.

Single Arm Curl (Cable).instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley holding a handle in one hand with an underhand grip. Curl the handle upward toward your shoulder, then lower back down with control and repeat, then switch sides.
instruction_steps: Attach a handle to a low pulley and stand facing the machine.
Grip the handle with an underhand grip, arm extended.
Curl the handle upward toward your shoulder.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control, then switch arms after completing your reps.

Spider Curl (Barbell).instructions: Lean chest-down against an incline bench holding a barbell with an underhand grip, arms hanging straight down. Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Set an incline bench to a steep angle and lean your chest against it.
Hold a barbell with an underhand grip, arms hanging straight down.
Curl the bar upward toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Lower the bar back down with control and repeat.

Spider Curl (Dumbbell).instructions: Lean chest-down against an incline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down. Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Set an incline bench to a steep angle and lean your chest against it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down.
Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control and repeat.

Waiter Curl (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell vertically with both hands cupped under the top plate, like carrying a tray. Curl the dumbbell upward toward your chest, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a dumbbell vertically with both hands under the top plate.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl the dumbbell upward toward your chest.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbell back down with control and repeat.

Zottman Curl (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip. Curl the dumbbells upward, then rotate your wrists to an overhand grip at the top and lower them back down slowly in that position.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip.
Curl the dumbbells upward toward your shoulders as in a standard curl.
At the top, rotate your wrists so your palms face downward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back down in this overhand grip.
Rotate back to an underhand grip at the bottom and repeat.

Calf Extension (Machine).instructions: Sit in the calf extension machine with the balls of your feet on the platform and pads resting on your thighs. Press up onto your toes by extending your ankles, then lower your heels back down with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the machine and sit with the balls of your feet on the platform.
Position the thigh pads securely and select a resistance.
Press through your toes to extend your ankles upward.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your calves.
Lower your heels back down with control and repeat.

Calf Press (Machine).instructions: Sit in the leg press machine with only the balls of your feet on the lower part of the platform. Press the platform away by extending your ankles, then return with control by allowing your heels to drop.
instruction_steps: Sit in the leg press machine and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
Extend your legs to unrack the weight, keeping knees slightly bent.
Press through your toes to push the platform away.
Pause briefly at full extension, squeezing your calves.
Allow your heels to lower back down with control and repeat.

Seated Calf Raise.instructions: Sit with the balls of your feet on a raised platform and a padded weight resting across your thighs. Press up onto your toes by extending your ankles, then lower your heels below the platform for a stretch.
instruction_steps: Sit at the seated calf raise machine with knees under the pad.
Place the balls of your feet on the platform.
Press through your toes to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your calves.
Lower your heels below the platform for a stretch and repeat.

Single Leg Standing Calf Raise.instructions: Stand on one leg with the ball of your foot on a raised edge or platform, holding something for balance. Press up onto your toes as high as possible, then lower your heel below the platform for a stretch.
instruction_steps: Stand on one leg with the ball of your foot on a raised edge.
Hold onto a support for balance if needed.
Press through your toes to raise your heel as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your calf.
Lower your heel below the platform for a stretch and repeat.

Single Leg Standing Calf Raise (Barbell).instructions: Stand on one leg with a barbell across your upper back, the ball of your foot on a raised platform. Press up onto your toes as high as possible, then lower your heel below the platform for a stretch.
instruction_steps: Position a barbell across your upper back as in a squat setup.
Stand on one leg with the ball of your foot on a raised platform.
Press through your toes to raise your heel as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your calf.
Lower your heel below the platform for a stretch and repeat.

Single Leg Standing Calf Raise (Dumbbell.instructions: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the same-side hand, the ball of your foot on a raised platform. Press up onto your toes as high as possible, then lower your heel below the platform for a stretch.
instruction_steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on the same-side leg.
Place the ball of your foot on a raised platform, holding a support for balance.
Press through your toes to raise your heel as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your calf.
Lower your heel below the platform for a stretch and repeat.

Single Leg Standing Calf Raise (Machine).instructions: Position one foot on the calf raise machine platform with the pad on your shoulder, ball of your foot on the edge. Press up onto your toes as high as possible, then lower your heel below the platform for a stretch.
instruction_steps: Position yourself in the standing calf raise machine, one foot on the platform.
Rest the shoulder pad securely and select a resistance.
Press through your toes to raise your heel as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your calf.
Lower your heel below the platform for a stretch and repeat.

Standing Calf Raise.instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a raised platform, legs straight. Press up onto your toes as high as possible by extending your ankles, then lower your heels below the platform for a full stretch.
instruction_steps: Stand with the balls of your feet on a raised platform or step.
Keep your legs straight and core braced.
Press through your toes to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your calves.
Lower your heels below the platform for a stretch and repeat.

Standing Calf Raise (Barbell).instructions: Stand with a barbell across your upper back, balls of your feet on a raised platform. Press up onto your toes as high as possible, then lower your heels below the platform for a full stretch.
instruction_steps: Position a barbell across your upper back as in a squat setup.
Stand with the balls of your feet on a raised platform.
Press through your toes to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your calves.
Lower your heels below the platform for a stretch and repeat.

Standing Calf Raise (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides, balls of your feet on a raised platform. Press up onto your toes as high as possible, then lower your heels below the platform for a full stretch.
instruction_steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with the balls of your feet on a raised platform.
Keep your legs straight and core braced.
Press through your toes to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your calves.
Lower your heels below the platform for a stretch and repeat.

Standing Calf Raise (Machine).instructions: Position yourself in the standing calf raise machine with the pads on your shoulders, balls of your feet on the platform. Press up onto your toes as high as possible, then lower your heels for a full stretch.
instruction_steps: Position yourself in the standing calf raise machine, shoulders under the pads.
Place the balls of your feet on the platform and select a resistance.
Press through your toes to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your calves.
Lower your heels below the platform for a stretch and repeat.

Standing Calf Raise (Smith).instructions: Stand under a Smith machine bar set at shoulder height, balls of your feet on a raised platform. Unrack the bar, then press up onto your toes as high as possible, and lower your heels for a full stretch.
instruction_steps: Set the Smith machine bar across your upper back and unrack it.
Stand with the balls of your feet on a raised platform.
Press through your toes to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your calves.
Lower your heels below the platform for a stretch and repeat.

Aerobics.instructions: Follow a structured sequence of rhythmic, continuous movements set to music, such as step patterns, kicks, and arm movements, at a pace that elevates your heart rate for the duration of the session.
instruction_steps: Warm up with light movement for a few minutes.
Follow the instructor or routine's rhythmic movement patterns.
Maintain continuous motion to keep your heart rate elevated.
Adjust intensity by increasing range of motion or pace.
Cool down with slower movements at the end of the session.

Air Bike.instructions: Lie flat on your back with your hands placed behind your head. Lift your legs off the ground and bend your knees at a 90-degree angle. Bring your right elbow towards your left knee while simultaneously straightening your right leg. Return to the starting position and repeat the movement on the opposite side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee while straightening your left leg. Continue alternating sides in a pedaling motion for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on your back with your hands placed behind your head.
Lift your legs off the ground and bend your knees at a 90-degree angle.
Bring your right elbow towards your left knee while simultaneously straightening your right leg.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement on the opposite side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee while straightening your left leg.
Continue alternating sides in a pedaling motion for the desired number of repetitions.

Battle Ropes.instructions: Stand holding one end of a heavy rope in each hand, knees slightly bent and core braced. Alternate whipping the ropes up and down as forcefully as possible, creating continuous waves for the desired duration.
instruction_steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding one rope end in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and brace your core.
Alternate whipping each arm up and down to create waves in the rope.
Maintain a fast, consistent rhythm for the desired duration.
Rest and repeat for additional rounds as needed.

Boxing.instructions: Adopt a boxing stance with hands guarding your face and throw a combination of punches such as jabs, crosses, and hooks at a bag or pads, maintaining footwork and rotating your hips to generate power.
instruction_steps: Adopt a boxing stance with hands up guarding your face.
Throw jabs, crosses, hooks, or uppercuts at a bag or pads.
Rotate your hips and pivot your feet to generate punching power.
Keep moving your feet and return to guard position between punches.
Continue combinations for the desired rounds or duration.

Climbing.instructions: Ascend a climbing wall or natural rock face by finding hand and foot holds, using your legs to push your body upward while your arms stabilize and guide movement, maintaining balance throughout.
instruction_steps: Assess the route and identify hand and foot holds.
Push primarily through your legs to move upward.
Use your arms mainly for balance and stabilization.
Keep your hips close to the wall for better weight distribution.
Continue climbing to the top or desired point, then descend safely.

Cycling.instructions: Sit on a bicycle or stationary bike with proper seat height, and pedal continuously at a steady cadence, adjusting resistance or terrain to control intensity for the desired duration.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat height so your leg is nearly straight at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
Begin pedaling at a comfortable, steady cadence.
Adjust resistance or gear to control the intensity.
Maintain an upright or slightly forward posture depending on the bike type.
Continue for the desired distance or duration, cooling down at the end.

Elliptical Trainer.instructions: Stand on the elliptical machine's pedals, gripping the moving or stationary handles, and drive the pedals in a smooth, continuous elliptical motion, adjusting resistance and incline to control intensity.
instruction_steps: Step onto the pedals and grip the handles.
Begin moving your legs in a smooth elliptical motion.
Push and pull the handles if using the upper body component.
Adjust resistance and incline to control the intensity.
Continue for the desired duration, cooling down at the end.

HIIT.instructions: Alternate short bursts of maximal or near-maximal effort exercise with brief periods of rest or low-intensity recovery, repeating this cycle for a set number of rounds to elevate heart rate and metabolic demand.
instruction_steps: Choose one or more exercises such as sprints, burpees, or bike sprints.
Perform the exercise at maximum effort for a short interval.
Rest or move at low intensity for a brief recovery period.
Repeat the work-to-rest cycle for the prescribed number of rounds.
Cool down with light activity and stretching afterward.

Hiking.instructions: Walk at a steady pace over varied outdoor terrain, adjusting your stride and pace for inclines and uneven ground, while maintaining good posture and using trekking poles if needed for stability.
instruction_steps: Choose a trail suited to your fitness level and plan your route.
Walk at a steady, sustainable pace, adjusting for terrain.
Use shorter strides and engage your glutes on inclines.
Stay hydrated and take breaks as needed.
Maintain good posture throughout, especially on descents.

Jump Rope.instructions: Hold the handles of the jump rope with your hands, palms facing inward. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Swing the rope over your head and jump over it as it comes towards your feet. Land softly on the balls of your feet and repeat the jump as the rope comes around again. Continue jumping for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Hold the handles of the jump rope with your hands, palms facing inward.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Swing the rope over your head and jump over it as it comes towards your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and repeat the jump as the rope comes around again.
Continue jumping for the desired duration or number of repetitions.

Rowing Machine.instructions: Sit on the rowing machine with feet secured and knees bent, gripping the handle. Drive through your legs, then lean back and pull the handle to your torso, before reversing the motion smoothly to return to the start.
instruction_steps: Sit on the machine with feet secured in the straps and knees bent.
Grip the handle with both hands and lean slightly forward.
Drive through your legs first, then lean back and pull the handle to your torso.
Extend your arms, then bend forward and slide your knees back to the start.
Repeat the sequence at a steady rhythm for the desired duration.

Running.instructions: Maintain an upright posture with a slight forward lean, land midfoot under your hips, and drive your arms and legs in a continuous rhythmic motion at a pace suited to your goal, whether steady-state or interval.
instruction_steps: Warm up with a few minutes of walking or light jogging.
Maintain an upright posture with a slight forward lean.
Land midfoot under your hips with a relaxed stride.
Drive your arms in rhythm with your legs.
Maintain your target pace for the desired distance or duration.

Skating.instructions: Push off alternately with each leg in a gliding motion, keeping your knees bent and core engaged for balance, using your arms to help propel and stabilize your movement across the surface.
instruction_steps: Bend your knees slightly and keep your core engaged for balance.
Push off with one leg, gliding on the other.
Alternate legs in a continuous side-to-side pushing motion.
Use your arms to help with balance and propulsion.
Continue at a steady pace for the desired distance or duration.

Skiing.instructions: Maintain a slightly crouched stance with knees bent and weight centered over your skis, using your poles for balance and propulsion while carving or gliding down the slope in a controlled manner.
instruction_steps: Adopt a slightly crouched stance with knees bent.
Keep your weight centered over your skis.
Use your poles for balance and propulsion as needed.
Carve or turn by shifting weight between skis to control speed.
Maintain control throughout the descent, adjusting stance for terrain.

Snowboarding.instructions: Stand sideways on the board with knees bent and weight centered, shifting your weight between your toe and heel edges to control direction and speed while descending the slope in a controlled manner.
instruction_steps: Stand sideways on the board with knees bent and weight centered.
Shift weight toward your front foot to initiate movement.
Use toe and heel edge pressure to control turns.
Keep your upper body facing down the slope for balance.
Maintain control throughout the descent, adjusting stance for terrain.

Spinning.instructions: Sit or stand on a stationary spin bike and pedal continuously, following instructor cues or a set program to vary resistance, cadence, and posture throughout the session for varying intensity.
instruction_steps: Adjust the bike seat and handlebar height to fit your body.
Begin pedaling at a comfortable cadence to warm up.
Increase resistance and vary between seated and standing positions.
Follow interval or hill-climb segments as prescribed by the class or program.
Cool down with lower resistance and cadence at the end.

Sprints.instructions: From a standing or crouched start, accelerate as quickly as possible to top speed over a set distance, driving your knees and arms explosively, then decelerate gradually and recover before repeating.
instruction_steps: Start from a standing or crouched position.
Accelerate explosively, driving your knees and arms forward.
Reach and maintain maximum controlled speed over the set distance.
Decelerate gradually after crossing the finish point.
Recover with a walk or light jog before repeating for additional reps.

Stair Machine (Floors).instructions: Step onto the stair climber machine and continuously step as if climbing stairs, maintaining an upright posture and using the handrails only lightly for balance, tracking floors climbed as your metric.
instruction_steps: Step onto the machine and select your program or manual mode.
Begin stepping continuously as if climbing real stairs.
Maintain an upright posture without leaning heavily on the rails.
Keep a steady pace to accumulate floors climbed.
Continue for the desired number of floors or duration.

Stair Machine (Steps).instructions: Step onto the stair climber machine and continuously step as if climbing stairs, maintaining an upright posture and using the handrails only lightly for balance, tracking total steps as your metric.
instruction_steps: Step onto the machine and select your program or manual mode.
Begin stepping continuously as if climbing real stairs.
Maintain an upright posture without leaning heavily on the rails.
Keep a steady pace to accumulate total steps.
Continue for the desired number of steps or duration.

Swimming.instructions: Propel yourself through the water using a coordinated combination of arm strokes, leg kicks, and breathing technique appropriate to your chosen stroke, maintaining a steady rhythm over the desired distance.
instruction_steps: Enter the water and position yourself in a streamlined posture.
Begin coordinated arm strokes and leg kicks for your chosen stroke.
Time your breathing with your stroke rhythm.
Maintain a steady, sustainable pace.
Continue for the desired distance or duration.

Treadmill.instructions: Set the treadmill to your desired speed and incline, then walk or run with an upright posture, landing midfoot and maintaining a natural arm swing for the duration of your session.
instruction_steps: Set the treadmill to a comfortable starting speed and incline.
Step onto the belt and find your stride, holding the rails briefly if needed.
Maintain an upright posture with a natural arm swing.
Adjust speed or incline as needed for your target intensity.
Cool down by gradually reducing speed at the end of the session.

Walking.instructions: Maintain an upright posture and walk at a steady, purposeful pace, letting your arms swing naturally and landing with a smooth heel-to-toe motion for the desired distance or duration.
instruction_steps: Stand tall with shoulders relaxed and core lightly engaged.
Begin walking at a steady, purposeful pace.
Let your arms swing naturally in rhythm with your steps.
Land with a smooth heel-to-toe motion.
Continue for the desired distance or duration.

Around The World.instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a light dumbbell in each hand above your chest with arms slightly bent. Sweep the dumbbells out to the sides and around in a wide arc toward your hips, then reverse the path back to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Lie on a flat bench holding a light dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout.
Sweep the dumbbells outward and down toward your hips in a wide arc.
Continue the circular path back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, keeping the motion controlled.

Bench Press (Barbell).instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a barbell racked above your chest, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width. Lower the bar to your mid-chest with control, then press it back up until your arms are fully extended.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on the bench with your eyes under the bar.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and unrack it.
Lower the bar with control to your mid-chest.
Press the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Bench Press (Cable).instructions: Lie on a flat bench positioned between two low cable pulleys, holding a handle in each hand at chest level. Press the handles up and together above your chest, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Position a flat bench between two low cable pulleys.
Lie down and grip a handle in each hand at chest level.
Press the handles up and together above your chest.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower the handles back down with control and repeat.

Bench Press (Dumbbell).instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, palms facing forward. Press the dumbbells up until your arms are fully extended, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on the bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Keep your feet flat on the floor for stability.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control and repeat.

Bench Press (Smith Machine).instructions: Lie on a flat bench under a Smith machine bar positioned above your chest. Unrack the bar, lower it to your mid-chest with control, then press it back up until your arms are fully extended.
instruction_steps: Position a flat bench under the Smith machine bar.
Lie down and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and lower it with control to your mid-chest.
Press the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Bench Press - Wide Grip (Barbell).instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a barbell racked above your chest, hands gripped significantly wider than shoulder-width. Lower the bar to your chest with control, then press it back up until your arms are fully extended.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on the bench with your eyes under the bar.
Grip the bar with a wide, wider-than-shoulder grip and unrack it.
Lower the bar with control to your chest.
Press the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Butterfly (Pec Deck).instructions: Sit in the pec deck machine with your back against the pad, forearms or hands on the arm pads. Bring the pads together in front of your chest, squeezing your pecs, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat so your shoulders align with the machine's pivot point.
Place your forearms or hands on the pads with elbows bent.
Bring the pads together in front of your chest.
Pause briefly at the point of full contraction.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Cable Fly Crossovers.instructions: Stand centered between two high cable pulleys holding a handle in each hand, arms extended out to the sides. Bring your hands together in front of your chest in an arcing motion, then return with control.
instruction_steps: Set both pulleys to a high position and attach handles.
Stand centered between the pulleys, arms extended out to the sides.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in an arcing path.
Pause briefly at full contraction, squeezing your chest.
Return your arms back out with control and repeat.

Chest Dip.instructions: Position yourself on parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight. Lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are below your elbows. Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Position yourself on parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are below your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Chest Dip (Assisted).instructions: Use an assisted dip machine or resistance band to support part of your bodyweight. Lean forward slightly and lower your body by bending your elbows, then press back up until your arms are extended.
instruction_steps: Set the assistance level on the machine or loop a band under your knees.
Grip the dip bars and lean your torso slightly forward.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Press back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Chest Dip (Weighted).instructions: Attach additional weight via a belt and grip the dip bars, leaning your torso forward slightly. Lower your body by bending your elbows, then press back up until your arms are fully extended.
instruction_steps: Attach a weight plate to a dip belt and grip the parallel bars.
Lean your torso slightly forward and support your body with arms extended.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Press back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Chest Fly (Band).instructions: Anchor a resistance band behind you at chest height, holding a handle in each hand with arms extended out to the sides. Bring your hands together in front of your chest, then return with control.
instruction_steps: Anchor a resistance band behind you at chest height.
Hold a handle in each hand, arms extended out to the sides.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in an arcing motion.
Pause briefly at full contraction.
Return your arms back out with control and repeat.

Chest Fly (Dumbbell).instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, arms slightly bent. Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch, then bring them back together above your chest.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout the movement.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop when you feel a stretch across your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest and repeat.

Chest Fly (Machine).instructions: Sit in the chest fly machine with your back against the pad, gripping the handles with arms slightly bent. Bring your hands together in front of your chest, squeezing your pecs, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat so the handles align with chest height.
Grip the handles with a slight bend in your elbows.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Pause briefly at full contraction.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Chest Fly (Suspension).instructions: Hold the suspension trainer handles and lean forward with your arms extended out to the sides, body straight. Bring your hands together in front of your chest by pressing your body forward, then extend back out with control.
instruction_steps: Hold the suspension straps and lean forward with arms extended to the sides.
Keep your body straight and core braced, feet planted.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Pause briefly at full contraction.
Extend your arms back out to the sides with control and repeat.

Chest Press (Band).instructions: Anchor a resistance band behind you at chest height, holding a handle in each hand. Press the handles forward until your arms are fully extended, then return with control.
instruction_steps: Anchor a resistance band behind you at chest height.
Hold a handle in each hand at chest level, elbows bent.
Press the handles forward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at full extension.
Return the handles back to your chest with control and repeat.

Chest Press (Machine).instructions: Sit in the chest press machine with your back against the pad, gripping the handles at chest level. Press the handles forward until your arms are fully extended, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat so the handles align with chest height.
Grip the handles with your back flat against the pad.
Press the handles forward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at full extension.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Clap Push Ups.instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands under your shoulders. Lower your chest to the floor, then push up explosively so your hands leave the ground, clap once in the air, and land back into the plank position.
instruction_steps: Start in a high plank position with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Push up explosively so your hands leave the ground.
Clap your hands together in the air before landing.
Absorb the landing softly and repeat.

Decline Bench Press (Barbell).instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured, holding a barbell above your lower chest. Lower the bar with control, then press it back up until your arms are fully extended.
instruction_steps: Secure your feet at the top of the decline bench.
Lie back and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower the bar with control to your lower chest.
Press the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Decline Bench Press (Dumbbell).instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured, holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level. Press the dumbbells up until your arms are fully extended, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Secure your feet at the top of the decline bench.
Lie back holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control and repeat.

Decline Bench Press (Machine).instructions: Sit or lie in the decline press machine with your grips at lower chest level. Press the handles forward and up against the resistance, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Position yourself in the decline press machine, gripping the handles.
Select an appropriate resistance.
Press the handles forward and up until your arms are extended.
Pause briefly at full extension.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Decline Bench Press (Smith Machine).instructions: Lie on a decline bench under a Smith machine bar with feet secured. Unrack the bar, lower it with control to your lower chest, then press it back up until your arms are fully extended.
instruction_steps: Position a decline bench under the Smith machine bar and secure your feet.
Lie back and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and lower it with control to your lower chest.
Press the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Decline Chest Fly (Dumbbell).instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured, holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, arms slightly bent. Lower the dumbbells out to the sides until you feel a stretch, then bring them back together above your chest.
instruction_steps: Secure your feet at the top of the decline bench.
Lie back holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop when you feel a stretch across your lower chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest and repeat.

Decline Push Up.instructions: Place your feet on an elevated surface such as a bench, with your hands on the floor under your shoulders. Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows, then push back up until your arms are extended.
instruction_steps: Place your feet on an elevated bench or box.
Position your hands on the floor under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Push back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Dumbbell Squeeze Press.instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding two dumbbells pressed together above your chest with palms facing each other. Press the dumbbells upward while squeezing them together, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on a bench holding two dumbbells pressed together above your chest.
Squeeze the dumbbells firmly together throughout the movement.
Lower the dumbbells to your chest while maintaining the squeeze.
Press the dumbbells back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Feet Up Bench Press (Barbell).instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet raised off the floor, holding a barbell above your chest. Lower the bar with control to your mid-chest, then press it back up until your arms are fully extended.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on the bench and lift your feet off the floor, knees bent.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and unrack it.
Lower the bar with control to your mid-chest.
Press the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, keeping your feet elevated.

Floor Press (Barbell).instructions: Lie on the floor with your knees bent, holding a barbell above your chest. Lower the bar until your upper arms touch the floor, then press it back up until your arms are fully extended.
instruction_steps: Lie on the floor with knees bent and feet flat.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and hold it above your chest.
Lower the bar until your upper arms rest on the floor.
Press the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Floor Press (Dumbbell).instructions: Lie on the floor with your knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest. Lower the dumbbells until your upper arms touch the floor, then press them back up until your arms are fully extended.
instruction_steps: Lie on the floor with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
