Lower the dumbbells until your upper arms rest on the floor.
Press the dumbbells back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Hex Press (Dumbbell).instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding two dumbbells pressed together above your chest, ends touching. Lower the dumbbells to your chest while keeping them pressed together, then press back up until your arms are fully extended.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on a bench holding two hex dumbbells pressed together above your chest.
Keep the dumbbell ends pressed together throughout the movement.
Lower the dumbbells to your chest with control.
Press the dumbbells back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Incline Bench Press (Barbell).instructions: Lie on an incline bench set to about 30-45 degrees, holding a barbell above your upper chest. Lower the bar with control to your upper chest, then press it back up until your arms are fully extended.
instruction_steps: Set the bench to an incline of about 30-45 degrees.
Lie back and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower the bar with control to your upper chest.
Press the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell).instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level. Press the dumbbells up until your arms are fully extended, then lower back down with control to your upper chest.
instruction_steps: Set the bench to an incline of about 30-45 degrees.
Lie back holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control and repeat.

Incline Bench Press (Smith Machine).instructions: Lie on an incline bench under a Smith machine bar positioned above your upper chest. Unrack the bar, lower it with control, then press it back up until your arms are fully extended.
instruction_steps: Position an incline bench under the Smith machine bar.
Lie back and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Unrack the bar and lower it with control to your upper chest.
Press the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Incline Chest Fly (Dumbbell).instructions: Lie on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your upper chest, arms slightly bent. Lower the dumbbells out to the sides until you feel a stretch, then bring them back together above your chest.
instruction_steps: Set the bench to an incline of about 30-45 degrees.
Lie back holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop when you feel a stretch across your upper chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest and repeat.

Incline Chest Press (Machine).instructions: Sit in the incline chest press machine with your back against the angled pad, gripping the handles at shoulder level. Press the handles forward and up until your arms are fully extended, then return slowly.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat so the handles align with your upper chest.
Grip the handles with your back flat against the pad.
Press the handles forward and up until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at full extension.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Incline Push Ups.instructions: Place your hands on an elevated surface such as a bench or step, with your body in a straight line. Lower your chest toward the surface by bending your elbows, then push back up until your arms are extended.
instruction_steps: Place your hands on an elevated bench or step, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs back so your body forms a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the surface with control.
Push back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Iso-Lateral Chest Press (Machine).instructions: Sit in the iso-lateral chest press machine gripping each handle independently at chest level. Press both handles forward until your arms are fully extended, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat so the handles align with chest height.
Grip each handle independently, back flat against the pad.
Press both handles forward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at full extension.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Kneeling Push Up.instructions: Start on your hands and knees with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, body straight from knees to head. Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows, then push back up until your arms are extended.
instruction_steps: Kneel on the floor with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Push back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Low Cable Fly Crossovers.instructions: Stand centered between two low cable pulleys holding a handle in each hand, arms extended down and out to the sides. Bring your hands upward and together in front of your upper chest, then return with control.
instruction_steps: Set both pulleys to a low position and attach handles.
Stand centered between the pulleys, arms extended down and out.
Bring your hands upward and together in front of your upper chest.
Pause briefly at full contraction.
Return your arms back down and out with control and repeat.

One Arm Push Up.instructions: Start in a high plank position with your feet spread wide for balance and one hand on the floor, the other behind your back. Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbow, then push back up until your arm is extended.
instruction_steps: Start in a high plank position with feet spread wide for balance.
Place one hand centered under your chest and the other behind your back.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Push back up until your arm is fully extended.
Complete your reps, then switch to the other arm.

Plank Pushup.instructions: Start in a forearm plank position, then push up one arm at a time into a high plank with hands under your shoulders, and lower back down one arm at a time to the forearm plank, alternating the leading arm.
instruction_steps: Start in a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders.
Push up onto one hand, then the other, into a high plank.
Keep your hips level and core braced throughout.
Lower back down onto one forearm, then the other.
Continue alternating the leading arm for the desired repetitions.

Plate Press.instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a weight plate with both hands above your chest, palms pressing into the plate. Lower the plate to your chest, then press it back up until your arms are fully extended.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on a bench holding a weight plate with both hands.
Press your palms firmly into the plate throughout the movement.
Lower the plate down to your chest with control.
Press the plate back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Plate Squeeze (Svend Press).instructions: Stand holding two weight plates pressed together between your palms at chest height. Press the plates straight out in front of you while squeezing them together, then return to your chest with control.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding two weight plates pressed together at chest height.
Squeeze the plates firmly together with your palms.
Press the plates straight out in front of your chest.
Pause briefly at full extension, maintaining the squeeze.
Return the plates back to your chest with control and repeat.

Push Up.instructions: Start in a high plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, body straight from head to heels. Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows, then push back up until your arms are extended.
instruction_steps: Start in a high plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Push back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Push Up (Weighted).instructions: Start in a high plank position with a weight plate placed on your upper back, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width. Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows, then push back up until your arms are extended.
instruction_steps: Have a partner place a weight plate on your upper back, or use a weighted vest.
Start in a high plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Push back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Push Up - Close Grip.instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands close together beneath your chest, forming a diamond or narrow shape. Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows, then push back up until your arms are extended.
instruction_steps: Start in a high plank position with hands close together under your chest.
Keep your elbows tucked close to your body.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Push back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Ring Dips.instructions: Start by hanging from the rings with your arms fully extended and your body straight. Lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are below your elbows. Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Start by hanging from the rings with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are below your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Ring Push Up.instructions: Position gymnastic rings just above the floor and grip one in each hand in a high plank position. Lower your chest toward the rings by bending your elbows, keeping the rings stable, then push back up until your arms are extended.
instruction_steps: Set gymnastic rings just above floor height.
Grip one ring in each hand in a high plank position.
Lower your chest toward the rings with control, keeping them stable.
Push back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Seated Chest Flys (Cable).instructions: Sit on a bench positioned between two cable pulleys set at chest height, holding a handle in each hand. Bring your hands together in front of your chest, then return with control to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Position a bench between two cable pulleys set at chest height.
Sit and grip a handle in each hand, arms extended out to the sides.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Pause briefly at full contraction.
Return your arms back out with control and repeat.

Single Arm Cable Crossover.instructions: Stand sideways to a high cable pulley holding the handle in one hand, arm extended out to the side. Bring your hand across your body in an arcing motion, then return with control, then switch sides.
instruction_steps: Set the pulley to a high position and stand sideways to the machine.
Grip the handle in one hand, arm extended out to the side.
Bring your hand across your body in an arcing motion.
Pause briefly at full contraction.
Return your arm back out with control, then switch sides after completing reps.

Behind the Back Bicep Wrist Curl (Barbel.instructions: Stand holding a barbell behind your back with an underhand grip, arms extended. Curl your wrists upward to lift the bar, contracting your forearms, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand upright and hold a barbell behind your back with an underhand grip.
Let the bar hang with your wrists relaxed.
Curl your wrists upward, lifting the bar as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower the bar back down with control and repeat.

Seated Palms Up Wrist Curl.instructions: Sit with your forearms resting on your thighs or a bench, palms facing up, holding a barbell or dumbbells. Curl your wrists upward, then lower them back down with control.
instruction_steps: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench, palms up.
Hold a barbell or dumbbells with your wrists hanging just off the edge.
Curl your wrists upward as far as possible.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your wrists back down with control and repeat.

Seated Wrist Extension (Barbell).instructions: Sit with your forearms resting on your thighs or a bench, palms facing down, holding a barbell. Extend your wrists upward, then lower them back down with control.
instruction_steps: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench, palms down.
Hold a barbell with your wrists hanging just off the edge.
Extend your wrists upward as far as possible.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your wrists back down with control and repeat.

Wrist Roller.instructions: Hold a wrist roller device with both hands extended in front of you, a weight attached by a cord. Rotate your wrists to wind the cord up, lifting the weight, then reverse the motion to lower it back down.
instruction_steps: Hold the wrist roller with both hands, arms extended in front of you.
Attach a light weight to the cord.
Rotate your wrists forward to wind the cord and lift the weight.
Continue until the weight reaches the top.
Reverse the rotation to slowly lower the weight back down.

Ball Slams.instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a slam ball with both hands. Raise the ball overhead by extending your body onto your toes, then forcefully slam it straight down into the floor in front of you, hinging at the hips as you slam. Catch the ball on the bounce or pick it back up and repeat.
instruction_steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the slam ball with both hands.
Raise the ball overhead, extending your body and rising onto your toes.
Brace your core and forcefully slam the ball straight down in front of your feet.
Hinge at the hips and follow through with your arms as the ball hits the floor.
Pick the ball back up or catch the bounce, then reset and repeat.

Burpee.instructions: Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart. Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and placing your hands on the floor in front of you. Kick your feet back into a push-up position. Perform a push-up, keeping your body in a straight line. Jump your feet back into the squat position. Jump up explosively, reaching your arms overhead. Land softly and immediately lower back into a squat position to begin the next repetition.
instruction_steps: Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and placing your hands on the floor in front of you.
Kick your feet back into a push-up position.
Perform a push-up, keeping your body in a straight line.
Jump your feet back into the squat position.
Jump up explosively, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly and immediately lower back into a squat position to begin the next repetition.

Burpee Over the Bar.instructions: Stand next to a barbell on the floor. Drop into a burpee by placing your hands down, kicking your feet back into a plank, performing a push-up, then jumping your feet back in and explosively jumping up and laterally over the bar. Land on the other side and repeat back over.
instruction_steps: Stand beside the barbell with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor, then kick your feet back into a plank.
Perform a push-up, then jump your feet back in toward your hands.
Explosively jump up and sideways, clearing the bar with both feet.
Land softly on the other side and immediately repeat back over the bar.

Clean.instructions: Set up over the barbell with feet hip-width apart and hands just outside your legs. Pull the bar from the floor explosively, extending your hips and shrugging aggressively, then pull yourself under the bar to catch it in a front rack position on your shoulders. Stand up fully to complete the lift.
instruction_steps: Set up with the bar over your midfoot, shins close, hips low, and back flat.
Pull the bar from the floor, keeping it close as you pass your knees.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles, then shrug hard.
Pull yourself under the bar quickly and catch it on your front shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand up fully to complete the lift, elbows high in the front rack.

Clean and Jerk.instructions: Perform a clean to bring the bar from the floor to your shoulders, standing up fully. From the front rack, dip slightly at the knees, then drive the bar overhead explosively while splitting or pushing your feet, locking out your arms to finish the jerk.
instruction_steps: Clean the bar from the floor to your shoulders and stand up fully.
From the front rack position, take a short dip by bending your knees slightly.
Drive upward explosively, pressing the bar off your shoulders.
Split or push your feet out as you punch the bar overhead to lockout.
Bring your feet back in line and stand tall with the bar locked out overhead.

Clean and Press.instructions: Clean the barbell from the floor to your shoulders in one explosive pull, standing up to a front rack position. From there, press the bar overhead in a strict motion without using leg drive, then lower it back down under control before setting it back on the floor.
instruction_steps: Clean the bar from the floor to your shoulders, standing up fully.
Brace your core with the bar resting on your front shoulders.
Press the bar straight overhead using only your arms and shoulders.
Lock out your elbows at the top with the bar over your midline.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders under control, then return it to the floor.

Clean Pull.instructions: Set up over the barbell as if performing a clean, with hips low and back flat. Pull the bar from the floor, accelerating as it passes your knees, and finish with a full hip extension and shrug, without pulling yourself under the bar. Lower the bar back to the floor with control.
instruction_steps: Set up over the bar with hips low, shins close, and back flat.
Pull the bar off the floor, keeping it close to your shins and thighs.
Accelerate the bar as it passes your knees into the power position.
Explosively extend your hips and shrug your shoulders as high as possible.
Lower the bar back to the floor under control and reset.

Deadlift High Pull.instructions: Deadlift a barbell from the floor to hip height with a controlled pull. Once at hip level, explosively extend your hips and pull the bar upward using your arms, driving your elbows high and out to the sides until the bar reaches chest height. Lower the bar back down and repeat.
instruction_steps: Set up over the bar as in a standard deadlift, with hips low and back flat.
Pull the bar from the floor to hip height in a controlled deadlift motion.
Explosively extend your hips as the bar reaches your thighs.
Pull the bar upward with your arms, driving your elbows high and wide.
Lower the bar back to the floor under control and repeat.

Downward Dog.instructions: Start on your hands and knees, then lift your hips up and back, straightening your arms and legs to form an inverted V-shape. Press your heels toward the floor and your chest toward your thighs, holding the position while breathing steadily.
instruction_steps: Begin on your hands and knees, with hands slightly ahead of your shoulders.
Tuck your toes under and lift your hips up and back.
Straighten your arms and legs, forming an inverted V-shape with your body.
Press your heels toward the floor and relax your neck and shoulders.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, then release back to your knees.

Dumbbell Snatch.instructions: Stand over a dumbbell placed between your feet, hinging at the hips to grip it with one hand. Pull the dumbbell explosively off the floor, extending your hips and shrugging, then punch it overhead in one continuous motion as you drop slightly into a quarter squat, finishing with your arm locked out overhead.
instruction_steps: Stand over the dumbbell with feet shoulder-width apart and hinge to grip it with one hand.
Pull the dumbbell off the floor, keeping it close to your body as it passes your knees.
Explosively extend your hips and shrug your shoulder as the dumbbell rises.
Punch the dumbbell overhead by pulling yourself slightly under it into a quarter squat.
Stand up fully with your arm locked out overhead, then lower the dumbbell back down.

Farmers Walk.instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides. Keep your back straight and your shoulders back. Take small, controlled steps forward, maintaining an upright posture. Continue walking for the desired distance or time. To finish, stop walking and carefully lower the dumbbells to your sides.
instruction_steps: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
Keep your back straight and your shoulders back.
Take small, controlled steps forward, maintaining an upright posture.
Continue walking for the desired distance or time.
To finish, stop walking and carefully lower the dumbbells to your sides.

Front Lever Hold.instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip. Engage your lats, core, and shoulders to raise your body into a horizontal position, keeping your arms straight and your body parallel to the floor. Hold this position for time, keeping your hips level with your shoulders.
instruction_steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Engage your lats and core, pulling your shoulder blades down and back.
Raise your legs and hips, bringing your body toward a horizontal line.
Keep your arms straight and your body rigid, parallel to the floor.
Hold the position for the desired time, then lower back down under control.

Front Lever Raise.instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and your body hanging vertically. Engage your core and lats, then raise your straight legs and hips upward until your body reaches a horizontal front lever position. Lower back down under control to the starting hang.
instruction_steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Keeping your legs straight, raise your hips and legs upward.
Continue raising until your body is horizontal in the front lever position.
Lower back down slowly to the starting hang and repeat.

Handstand Hold.instructions: Place your hands shoulder-width apart on the floor a short distance from a wall. Kick up into a handstand, using the wall for balance and support, keeping your body straight and core braced. Hold the position, pressing firmly through your hands, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Place your hands shoulder-width apart on the floor near a wall.
Kick one leg up followed by the other, walking your feet up the wall for support.
Straighten your body into a vertical line, engaging your core and glutes.
Press firmly through your hands and hold the position, keeping your breathing steady.
Walk your feet back down the wall to exit the handstand with control.

Hang Clean.instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip, lowering it to just above or below the knees in a hang position. Explosively extend your hips, shrug, and pull yourself under the bar, catching it on your front shoulders in a quarter squat. Stand up fully to complete the lift.
instruction_steps: Stand holding the bar with an overhand grip, lowering it to the hang position above the knees.
Hinge your hips back slightly, keeping your back flat and shins vertical.
Explosively extend your hips and shrug your shoulders as high as possible.
Pull yourself under the bar quickly and catch it on your front shoulders.
Stand up fully to finish the lift with elbows high in the front rack.

Hang Snatch.instructions: Stand holding a barbell with a wide overhand grip, lowering it to a hang position above the knees. Explosively extend your hips and pull the bar upward, then drop under it to catch it overhead with straight arms in a quarter squat. Stand up fully to complete the lift.
instruction_steps: Stand holding the bar with a wide grip, lowering it to the hang position above the knees.
Hinge your hips back slightly, keeping your back flat and the bar close to your thighs.
Explosively extend your hips and pull the bar upward, shrugging hard.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it overhead with locked arms.
Stand up fully to complete the lift with the bar stable overhead.

High Knee Skips.instructions: Move forward with a skipping motion, driving one knee up toward your chest while hopping off the opposite foot, then switching sides with each skip. Pump your arms in rhythm with your legs and keep your chest tall as you travel forward.
instruction_steps: Stand tall with your chest up and arms relaxed at your sides.
Skip forward, driving one knee up toward your chest as you hop off the other foot.
Pump your opposite arm forward as your knee rises.
Land softly and immediately switch to drive the other knee up.
Continue skipping forward for the desired distance or time.

High Knees.instructions: Stand tall and run in place, driving your knees up toward your chest as quickly as possible while pumping your arms. Land lightly on the balls of your feet and keep your core braced throughout the movement.
instruction_steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and arms bent at your sides.
Drive one knee up toward your chest quickly, landing on the ball of your foot.
Immediately switch and drive the other knee up in a running motion.
Pump your arms in rhythm with your legs to maintain pace.
Continue alternating quickly for the desired time or repetitions.

Jump Shrug.instructions: Hold a barbell with an overhand grip in front of your thighs, hips slightly hinged. Explosively extend your hips and ankles while jumping straight up, shrugging your shoulders hard at the top of the jump, then land softly and lower the bar back down.
instruction_steps: Stand holding the bar in front of your thighs with a slight hip hinge.
Brace your core and prepare to jump straight upward.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles as you jump.
Shrug your shoulders hard at the peak of the jump, keeping arms straight.
Land softly with bent knees and lower the bar back to the starting position.

Jumping Jack.instructions: Stand tall with your feet together and arms at your sides. Jump your feet out to the sides while simultaneously raising your arms overhead, then jump back to the starting position with feet together and arms lowered. Repeat at a steady rhythm.
instruction_steps: Stand tall with feet together and arms resting at your sides.
Jump your feet out to shoulder-width or wider.
Simultaneously raise your arms overhead as your feet land.
Jump your feet back together while lowering your arms back down.
Repeat continuously at a steady, controlled rhythm.

Kettlebell Clean.instructions: Stand over a kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart, gripping the handle with one hand. Hike the kettlebell back slightly, then explosively pull it upward close to your body, rotating your wrist to catch it in the rack position at your shoulder without banging your forearm.
instruction_steps: Stand over the kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart and grip the handle.
Hike the kettlebell back slightly between your legs to load the movement.
Explosively extend your hips and pull the kettlebell upward, keeping it close to your body.
Rotate your wrist through as the bell rises to catch it softly in the rack position.
Lower the kettlebell back down under control and repeat.

Kettlebell High Pull.instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of your hips. Hinge slightly and swing the kettlebell back, then explosively extend your hips and pull the kettlebell upward with your elbow leading, driving it to roughly chest height.
instruction_steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the kettlebell in front of your hips.
Hinge at the hips slightly and swing the kettlebell back between your legs.
Explosively extend your hips to drive the kettlebell forward and upward.
Pull with your arm, leading with the elbow, to raise the bell to chest height.
Lower the kettlebell back down under control and repeat.

Kettlebell Snatch.instructions: Stand over a kettlebell with feet shoulder-width apart, hiking it back between your legs with one hand. Explosively extend your hips to swing the kettlebell upward, punching your arm through so the bell rotates around your wrist and locks out overhead in one fluid motion.
instruction_steps: Stand over the kettlebell and grip the handle with one hand.
Hike the kettlebell back between your legs to load the hip hinge.
Explosively extend your hips, driving the kettlebell forward and upward.
Punch your arm through as the bell reaches shoulder height, locking it out overhead.
Lower the kettlebell back down under control through the same path and repeat.

Kettlebell Swing.instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward. Hold the kettlebell with both hands in front of your body, arms extended. Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips, pushing your butt back. Swing the kettlebell back between your legs, keeping your arms straight and maintaining a flat back. Drive your hips forward and swing the kettlebell up to shoulder height, using the momentum generated by your hips. Allow the kettlebell to swing back down between your legs and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward.
Hold the kettlebell with both hands in front of your body, arms extended.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips, pushing your butt back.
Swing the kettlebell back between your legs, keeping your arms straight and maintaining a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and swing the kettlebell up to shoulder height, using the momentum generated by your hips.
Allow the kettlebell to swing back down between your legs and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.

Kettlebell Turkish Get Up.instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell locked out overhead with one arm, knee bent on the same side. Press through your opposite forearm and hand to sit up, then sweep your back leg through into a lunge position, and stand up fully while keeping the kettlebell locked out overhead. Reverse the steps to return to the floor.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back holding the kettlebell locked out overhead with one arm, same-side knee bent.
Press through your opposite forearm to sit up onto your elbow, then your hand.
Lift your hips and sweep your back leg through to a kneeling lunge position.
Stand up fully from the lunge, keeping the kettlebell locked out overhead throughout.
Reverse each step in order to return to the floor with control.

Landmine Squat and Press.instructions: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at shoulder height with both hands. Perform a squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, then drive up out of the squat and press the bar forward and up along its natural arc to full extension.
instruction_steps: Hold the landmine bar at shoulder height with both hands.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
Keep your chest up and the bar stable at your shoulder throughout the descent.
Drive up through your heels and press the bar forward and up as you stand.
Lower the bar back to your shoulder and repeat for the next rep.

Mountain Climber.instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line. Engage your core and bring your right knee towards your chest, then quickly switch and bring your left knee towards your chest. Continue alternating legs in a running motion, keeping your hips low and your core engaged. Maintain a steady pace and breathe evenly throughout the exercise. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and bring your right knee towards your chest, then quickly switch and bring your left knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating legs in a running motion, keeping your hips low and your core engaged.
Maintain a steady pace and breathe evenly throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Muscle Up.instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended. Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest. As you reach the top of the movement, transition your grip so that your palms are facing towards you. Continue pulling yourself up until your chest is above the bar and your arms are fully flexed. Reverse the movement by slowly lowering yourself back down to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
As you reach the top of the movement, transition your grip so that your palms are facing towards you.
Continue pulling yourself up until your chest is above the bar and your arms are fully flexed.
Reverse the movement by slowly lowering yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Overhead Squat.instructions: Hold a barbell locked out overhead with a wide snatch-width grip. Keeping your arms locked and the bar stable over your midfoot, squat down by pushing your hips back and bending your knees until your hips drop below parallel, then drive back up to standing.
instruction_steps: Grip the bar wide and press it overhead with your arms locked out.
Set your feet shoulder-width apart, keeping the bar stable over your midfoot.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to descend into a squat.
Keep your chest tall and the bar directly overhead throughout the descent.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, maintaining the overhead lockout.

Pilates.instructions: Perform a sequence of controlled, low-impact movements focusing on core stability, breath control, and flexibility, typically on a mat or with light equipment. Move slowly and deliberately through each exercise, emphasizing precise alignment and controlled breathing rather than speed or heavy resistance.
instruction_steps: Set up on a mat with enough space to move your arms and legs freely.
Begin with gentle warm-up movements, focusing on breath and posture.
Move through each exercise slowly, engaging your core throughout.
Coordinate your breathing with each movement, exhaling on exertion.
Finish with a stretching or relaxation sequence to cool down.

Power Clean.instructions: Start with the barbell on the ground in front of you, with your feet shoulder-width apart. Bend down and grip the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Keep your back straight and chest up as you lift the barbell off the ground, extending your hips and knees. As the barbell reaches your mid-thigh, explosively pull it upwards, shrugging your shoulders and pulling your elbows high and to the sides. As the barbell reaches its highest point, quickly drop underneath it, rotating your elbows around and catching the barbell on your shoulders in a front squat position. Stand up with the barbell, fully extending your hips and knees. Lower the barbell back down to the starting position, keeping control of the weight throughout the movement. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Start with the barbell on the ground in front of you, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend down and grip the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and chest up as you lift the barbell off the ground, extending your hips and knees.
As the barbell reaches your mid-thigh, explosively pull it upwards, shrugging your shoulders and pulling your elbows high and to the sides.
As the barbell reaches its highest point, quickly drop underneath it, rotating your elbows around and catching the barbell on your shoulders in a front squat position.
Stand up with the barbell, fully extending your hips and knees.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position, keeping control of the weight throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Power Snatch.instructions: Set up over the barbell with a wide grip and hips low. Pull the bar explosively from the floor, extending your hips fully and shrugging hard, then pull yourself slightly under the bar to catch it overhead in a partial squat, higher than a full snatch catch. Stand up to complete the lift.
instruction_steps: Set up over the bar with a wide grip, hips low, and back flat.
Pull the bar from the floor, keeping it close as it passes your knees.
Explosively extend your hips and shrug hard as the bar accelerates.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it overhead in a quarter squat.
Stand up fully to complete the lift with the bar locked out overhead.

Press Under.instructions: Hold a barbell in the front rack or overhead starting position depending on the variation used. Drop your body quickly underneath the bar by bending your knees and dropping into a partial squat while pressing or catching the bar overhead, then stand up to lock it out fully.
instruction_steps: Start with the bar in the front rack or already pressed slightly overhead.
Drop quickly by bending your knees and hips into a partial squat.
Punch your arms upward as your body drops, meeting the bar overhead.
Catch the bar with locked arms in the bottom of the squat.
Stand up fully to finish with the bar stable overhead.

Sled Push.instructions: Load a sled with the desired weight and grip the handles at hip or shoulder height. Drive forward by taking short, powerful steps, keeping your body low and leaning into the sled, driving through your legs to push it across the floor.
instruction_steps: Load the sled with the appropriate weight for the exercise.
Grip the handles and set your body in a low, athletic stance leaning into the sled.
Drive forward with short, powerful steps, pushing through the balls of your feet.
Keep your core braced and your back flat as you push.
Continue driving forward for the desired distance, then reset for additional sets.

Snatch.instructions: Set up over the barbell with a wide grip and hips low. Pull the bar explosively from the floor, extending fully through the hips, then pull yourself under the bar and catch it overhead in a full squat with arms locked out. Stand up fully to complete the lift.
instruction_steps: Set up over the bar with a wide grip, hips low, and back flat.
Pull the bar from the floor, keeping it close as it passes your knees.
Explosively extend your hips and shrug hard as the bar accelerates upward.
Pull yourself under the bar quickly and catch it overhead in a full squat.
Stand up fully from the squat to complete the lift with arms locked out.

Split Jerk.instructions: From a front rack position, dip slightly by bending your knees, then drive the bar upward explosively while splitting one foot forward and the other back, punching your arms to lock the bar out overhead. Bring your feet back together to stand tall and finish the lift.
instruction_steps: Start with the bar in the front rack position, elbows high.
Take a short, controlled dip by bending your knees slightly.
Drive upward explosively, pressing the bar off your shoulders.
Split your feet, one forward and one back, as you punch the bar to lockout overhead.
Step your feet back together to stand tall with the bar locked out.

Squat Row.instructions: Stand holding a resistance band or cable attachment anchored in front of you, feet shoulder-width apart. Squat down by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, then as you stand back up, pull the handles back into a row, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
instruction_steps: Stand facing the anchor point, holding the handles with arms extended.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
Keep your chest up and arms extended throughout the descent.
As you drive up out of the squat, pull the handles into a row.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top, then reset and repeat.

Thruster (Barbell).instructions: Hold a barbell in the front rack position with elbows up. Squat down until your hips drop below parallel, then drive up explosively, using the momentum from your legs to press the bar overhead in one continuous motion. Lower the bar back to your shoulders and repeat.
instruction_steps: Hold the bar in the front rack position with your elbows up and chest tall.
Push your hips back and squat down until your hips drop below parallel.
Drive up explosively through your heels out of the squat.
Use the upward momentum to press the bar overhead to full lockout.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders as you descend into the next rep.

Thruster (Kettlebell).instructions: Hold two kettlebells in the rack position at your shoulders. Squat down until your hips drop below parallel, then drive up explosively and press the kettlebells overhead using the momentum from your legs. Lower them back to your shoulders and repeat.
instruction_steps: Hold the kettlebells in the rack position at your shoulders.
Push your hips back and squat down until your hips drop below parallel.
Drive up explosively through your heels out of the squat.
Use the upward momentum to press the kettlebells overhead to full lockout.
Lower the kettlebells back to your shoulders as you descend into the next rep.

Wall Ball.instructions: Hold a medicine ball at chest height and stand facing a wall target. Squat down until your hips drop below parallel, then drive up explosively and throw the ball upward to hit the target, catching it as it comes back down and absorbing the momentum into your next squat.
instruction_steps: Hold the medicine ball at chest height, standing an arm's length from the wall.
Push your hips back and squat down until your hips drop below parallel.
Drive up explosively through your heels out of the squat.
Extend your arms to throw the ball upward at the target on the wall.
Catch the ball as it returns and absorb it directly into your next squat.

Warm Up.instructions: Perform a short sequence of light cardio and dynamic movements to gradually raise your heart rate and body temperature before training. Include dynamic stretches and movement patterns similar to the exercises you plan to perform, progressing from low to moderate intensity.
instruction_steps: Begin with 3-5 minutes of light cardio such as jogging, cycling, or jumping rope.
Move into dynamic stretches for the major joints and muscle groups you'll be training.
Perform movement patterns similar to your workout at low intensity.
Gradually increase the intensity of your movements over several minutes.
Finish with a few light warm-up sets of your first exercise before starting your working sets.

Yoga.instructions: Move through a sequence of poses that combine controlled breathing with stretching, balance, and strength holds. Transition slowly between poses, holding each for several breaths while maintaining steady, controlled breathing throughout the practice.
instruction_steps: Set up on a mat in a quiet space with enough room to move freely.
Begin with a few minutes of seated or standing breathing to center yourself.
Move through a sequence of poses, holding each for several breaths.
Focus on alignment and controlled movement rather than speed.
Finish with a relaxation pose, breathing steadily for a few minutes.

Bird Dog.instructions: Start on your hands and knees with your spine in a neutral position. Simultaneously extend one arm forward and the opposite leg straight back, keeping your hips and shoulders level, then return to the starting position and switch sides.
instruction_steps: Get on your hands and knees, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your core to keep your spine neutral throughout the movement.
Extend one arm straight forward while extending the opposite leg straight back.
Hold briefly, keeping your hips and shoulders square to the floor.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.

Cable Pull Through.instructions: Stand facing away from a low cable pulley with the rope attachment between your legs. Hinge at your hips, pushing them back while keeping a slight knee bend, then drive your hips forward explosively to stand up, squeezing your glutes at the top.
instruction_steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from the machine.
Straddle the rope, holding one end in each hand between your legs.
Hinge at your hips, pushing them back while keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward explosively to stand up straight.
Squeeze your glutes at the top before hinging back down to repeat.

Clamshell.instructions: Lie on your side with your knees bent and stacked, hips and shoulders aligned. Keeping your feet together, raise your top knee upward like opening a clamshell, then lower it back down with control while keeping your pelvis stable.
instruction_steps: Lie on your side with knees bent at roughly 45 degrees and feet stacked together.
Rest your head on your arm or a pillow for support.
Keeping your feet in contact, raise your top knee upward without rotating your hips.
Pause briefly at the top, feeling the contraction in your outer hip.
Lower your knee back down with control and repeat before switching sides.

Deadlift (Band).instructions: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with feet hip-width apart, gripping a handle or the band itself in each hand. Hinge at your hips and bend your knees slightly to lower your torso, then drive through your heels to stand up, extending your hips fully at the top.
instruction_steps: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart, gripping the handles at hip level.
Hinge at your hips, pushing them back while keeping your back flat.
Bend your knees slightly as your torso lowers toward the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand up, extending your hips forward.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower back down with control.

Deadlift (Barbell).instructions: Stand with the barbell over your midfoot, feet hip-width apart. Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs, keeping your back flat, then drive through your heels to stand up, extending your hips and knees fully.
instruction_steps: Set up with the bar over your midfoot and feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs.
Flatten your back and pull your chest up so your shoulders are over the bar.
Drive through your heels, extending your hips and knees to stand up with the bar.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control by hinging at the hips first.

Deadlift (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart. Hinge at your hips and bend your knees slightly, lowering the dumbbells along your legs while keeping your back flat, then drive through your heels to stand back up.
instruction_steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Hinge at your hips, pushing them back while keeping a slight bend in your knees.
Lower the dumbbells along your legs, keeping your back flat and chest up.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then reverse the motion.
Drive through your heels to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.

Deadlift (Smith Machine).instructions: Stand inside the Smith machine with the bar over your midfoot. Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to grip the bar, keeping your back flat, then drive through your heels to stand up, extending your hips fully at the top of the movement.
instruction_steps: Set up inside the Smith machine with the bar positioned over your midfoot.
Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to grip the bar just outside your legs.
Flatten your back and pull your chest up so your shoulders are over the bar.
Unrack the bar by rotating it and drive through your heels to stand up.
Lower the bar back down with control by hinging at the hips first.

Deadlift (Trap bar).instructions: Stand inside a trap bar with feet hip-width apart. Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to grip the handles, keeping your chest up and back flat, then drive through your heels to stand up, extending your hips and knees fully at the top.
instruction_steps: Stand inside the trap bar with feet hip-width apart, centered between the handles.
Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to grip the handles at your sides.
Flatten your back and pull your chest up before initiating the lift.
Drive through your heels, extending your hips and knees to stand up with the bar.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control by hinging at the hips first.

Fire Hydrants.instructions: Get on your hands and knees with your spine neutral. Keeping your knee bent at roughly 90 degrees, lift one leg out to the side until your thigh is roughly parallel to the floor, then lower it back down with control and repeat before switching sides.
instruction_steps: Get on your hands and knees, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your core to keep your hips and spine stable.
Keeping your knee bent, lift one leg out to the side away from your body.
Raise until your thigh is roughly parallel to the floor without rotating your torso.
Lower back down with control and repeat before switching sides.

Frog Pumps (Dumbbell).instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out to the sides, holding a dumbbell on your hips. Drive your hips upward by squeezing your glutes, pausing at the top, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees relaxed outward.
Place a dumbbell across your hips, holding it steady with both hands.
Squeeze your glutes to drive your hips upward toward the ceiling.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your glutes hard.
Lower your hips back down with control and repeat.

Glute Bridge.instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Drive your hips upward by squeezing your glutes until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart.
Place your arms at your sides for stability.
Squeeze your glutes to drive your hips up toward the ceiling.
Pause at the top, forming a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower your hips back down with control and repeat.

Glute Kickback (Machine).instructions: Position yourself in the glute kickback machine with the pad against one foot or leg. Push your leg backward and upward by contracting your glute, keeping your torso stable, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the machine and place one foot against the pad, holding the handles for support.
Brace your core and keep your torso stable throughout the movement.
Push your leg back and up by contracting your glute.
Pause briefly at full extension, squeezing your glute.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat before switching sides.

Glute Kickback on Floor.instructions: Get on your hands and knees with your spine neutral. Keeping your knee bent at roughly 90 degrees, kick one leg back and up by contracting your glute until your thigh is in line with your torso, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Get on your hands and knees, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your core to keep your hips and spine stable.
Keeping your knee bent, kick one leg back and up by contracting your glute.
Raise until your thigh is roughly in line with your torso.
Lower back down with control and repeat before switching sides.

Hip Thrust.instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against a bench, knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Drive your hips upward by squeezing your glutes until your torso is parallel to the floor, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and feet flat on the floor.
Position your feet so your shins are roughly vertical at the top of the movement.
Squeeze your glutes to drive your hips upward until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top, keeping your chin tucked and core braced.
Lower your hips back down with control and repeat.

Hip Thrust (Barbell).instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell across your hips. Drive your hips upward by squeezing your glutes until your torso is parallel to the floor, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and roll a padded barbell over your hips.
Plant your feet flat on the floor, roughly shoulder-width apart.
Squeeze your glutes to drive your hips upward until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at the top, keeping your chin tucked and core braced.
Lower your hips back down with control and repeat.

Hip Thrust (Machine).instructions: Sit in the hip thrust machine with the pad positioned across your hips and your upper back supported. Drive your hips upward by squeezing your glutes until your torso is parallel to the floor, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the machine seat and pad so it rests across your hips with your upper back supported.
Plant your feet flat on the platform, roughly shoulder-width apart.
Squeeze your glutes to drive your hips upward against the resistance.
Pause briefly at the top, keeping your core braced.
Lower your hips back down with control and repeat.

Hip Thrust (Smith Machine).instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench positioned under the Smith machine bar, with the bar resting across your hips. Drive your hips upward by squeezing your glutes until your torso is parallel to the floor, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Position a bench under the Smith machine bar and sit with your upper back against it.
Roll the padded bar over your hips and unrack it by rotating the bar.
Plant your feet flat on the floor, roughly shoulder-width apart.
Squeeze your glutes to drive your hips upward until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Lower your hips back down with control and repeat.

Lateral Band Walks.instructions: Place a resistance band around your ankles or thighs and stand with feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent. Step sideways with one foot, keeping tension on the band, then bring the other foot in to a similar hip-width stance without releasing tension. Continue stepping in one direction before switching.
instruction_steps: Place a resistance band around your ankles or just above your knees.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent in a quarter squat.
Step sideways with one foot, keeping tension on the band.
Follow with the other foot, maintaining the same stance width.
Continue stepping sideways for the desired distance, then repeat in the opposite direction.

Lateral Leg Raises.instructions: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and straight, resting your head on your arm. Raise your top leg upward while keeping it straight, then lower it back down with control without letting it touch the bottom leg between reps.
instruction_steps: Lie on your side with your legs stacked straight and head resting on your arm.
Brace your core to keep your hips stacked and stable.
Raise your top leg upward, keeping it straight throughout.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat before switching sides.

Partial Glute Bridge (Barbell).instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, a padded barbell resting across your hips. Drive your hips upward through a shorter range of motion than a full bridge, focusing on squeezing your glutes hard at the top, then lower back down partway before repeating.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, barbell resting across your hips.
Grip the bar with both hands to keep it stable.
Drive your hips up through a partial range, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your hips only partway down before driving back up for the next rep.

Rear Kick (Machine).instructions: Position yourself in the rear kick machine with the pad against the back of one leg. Push your leg backward by contracting your glute, keeping your torso stable, then return to the starting position with control before switching legs.
instruction_steps: Adjust the machine and position the pad against the back of one leg.
Hold the handles and brace your core to keep your torso stable.
Push your leg backward by contracting your glute.
Pause briefly at full extension, squeezing your glute.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat before switching legs.

Reverse Hyperextension.instructions: Lie face down on a reverse hyperextension machine with your hips at the edge and legs hanging off holding the foot platform. Raise your legs upward by extending your hips until they're in line with your torso, then lower them back down with control.
instruction_steps: Lie face down on the machine with your hips at the edge and legs hanging below.
Grip the handles in front of you to stabilize your upper body.
Raise your legs upward by extending your hips until they're in line with your torso.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your glutes and lower back.
Lower your legs back down with control and repeat.

Single Leg Glute Bridge.instructions: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat on the floor, extending the other leg straight. Drive your hips upward by squeezing your glute on the supporting leg, then lower back down with control before switching legs.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and foot flat on the floor.
Extend the opposite leg straight, keeping it in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glute to drive your hips upward off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top, keeping your hips level.
Lower back down with control and repeat before switching legs.

Single Leg Hip Thrust.instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, one foot flat on the floor and the other leg extended straight. Drive your hips upward by squeezing your glute on the supporting leg, then lower back down with control before switching legs.
instruction_steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench.
Plant one foot flat on the floor and extend the other leg straight out.
Squeeze your glute on the supporting leg to drive your hips upward.
Pause briefly at the top, keeping your hips level and core braced.
Lower back down with control and repeat before switching legs.

Single Leg Hip Thrust (Dumbbell).instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, holding a dumbbell across your hips, one foot flat on the floor and the other leg extended straight. Drive your hips upward by squeezing your glute on the supporting leg, then lower back down with control before switching legs.
instruction_steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, holding a dumbbell on your hips.
Plant one foot flat on the floor and extend the other leg straight out.
Squeeze your glute on the supporting leg to drive your hips upward.
Pause briefly at the top, keeping your hips level and core braced.
Lower back down with control and repeat before switching legs.

Standing Cable Glute Kickbacks.instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable pulley and secure it around one ankle. Standing facing the machine and holding it for balance, kick your leg backward by contracting your glute, then return to the starting position with control before switching legs.
instruction_steps: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and secure it around one ankle.
Stand facing the machine, holding it for balance with both hands.
Kick your leg backward and upward by contracting your glute.
Pause briefly at full extension, avoiding arching your lower back.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat before switching legs.

Sumo Deadlift.instructions: Stand with a wide stance, toes pointed outward, and the barbell over your midfoot. Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to grip the bar with your hands inside your knees, keeping your back flat, then drive through your heels to stand up.
instruction_steps: Set up with a wide stance and toes pointed outward, bar over your midfoot.
Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to grip the bar with hands inside your legs.
Flatten your back and pull your chest up so your shoulders are over the bar.
Drive through your heels, extending your hips and knees to stand up with the bar.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control by hinging at the hips first.

Glute Ham Raise.instructions: Position yourself in a glute ham developer with your feet secured and knees on the pad. Lower your torso forward with control by extending at the knees, then use your hamstrings and glutes to pull yourself back up to the starting upright position.
instruction_steps: Secure your feet in the glute ham developer with your knees resting on the pad.
Start in an upright kneeling position with your torso straight.
Slowly lower your torso forward by extending at the knees, keeping your back flat.
Lower until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings, then stop.
Contract your hamstrings and glutes to pull yourself back up to the starting position.

Good Morning (Barbell).instructions: Stand with a barbell across your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart. Hinge at your hips, pushing them back while keeping a slight bend in your knees and your back flat, until your torso is close to parallel with the floor, then reverse the motion to stand back up.
instruction_steps: Position the barbell across your upper back, similar to a squat setup.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Hinge at your hips, pushing them back while keeping your back flat.
Lower your torso until it's close to parallel with the floor.
Drive your hips forward to return to standing and repeat.

Lying Leg Curl (Machine).instructions: Lie face down on the leg curl machine with the pad positioned just above your heels. Curl your legs upward by bending your knees, bringing your heels toward your glutes, then lower back down with control to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Lie face down on the machine with the ankle pad resting just above your heels.
Grip the handles for stability and keep your hips pressed into the pad.
Curl your legs upward by bending your knees, bringing your heels toward your glutes.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your hamstrings.
Lower back down with control to the starting position and repeat.

Nordic Hamstrings Curls.instructions: Kneel on a padded surface with your ankles secured under a fixed anchor or held by a partner. Keeping your body straight from knees to head, slowly lower your torso forward toward the floor, resisting with your hamstrings for as long as possible, then use your hands to catch yourself and push back up.
instruction_steps: Kneel on a pad with your ankles secured under an anchor or held by a partner.
Keep your body straight from your knees to your head, core braced.
Slowly lower your torso forward, resisting the fall with your hamstrings.
Lower for as long as you can control, then catch yourself with your hands.
Push back up with your hands and hamstrings to return to the kneeling position.

Romanian Deadlift (Barbell).instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart. Hinge at your hips, pushing them back while keeping a slight bend in your knees and the bar close to your legs, until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then drive your hips forward to stand back up.
instruction_steps: Stand holding the barbell in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips, pushing them back while keeping a slight bend in your knees.
Keep the bar close to your legs and your back flat as you lower.
Lower until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.

Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, feet hip-width apart. Hinge at your hips, pushing them back while keeping a slight bend in your knees and the dumbbells close to your legs, until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then drive your hips forward to stand back up.
instruction_steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Hinge at your hips, pushing them back while keeping a slight bend in your knees.
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs and your back flat as you lower.
Lower until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.

Seated Leg Curl (Machine).instructions: Sit in the leg curl machine with the pad positioned against the back of your ankles and legs extended. Curl your legs down and back by bending your knees, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the machine and sit with the ankle pad against the back of your ankles.
Grip the handles for stability and keep your back against the seat.
Curl your legs downward by bending your knees, bringing the pad toward the seat.
Pause briefly at the bottom, squeezing your hamstrings.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Single Leg Romanian Deadlift (Barbell).instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs, balancing on one leg with a slight bend in the knee. Hinge at your hips, lowering your torso while extending the opposite leg straight back, keeping the bar close to your body, then reverse the motion to return to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand holding the barbell in front of your thighs, weight on one leg.
Keep a slight bend in your standing knee to stabilize your balance.
Hinge at your hips, lowering your torso while extending your other leg straight back.
Keep the bar close to your body and your back flat throughout.
Reverse the motion, driving your hips forward to return to standing, then switch legs.

Single Leg Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, balancing on one leg with a slight bend in the knee. Hinge at your hips, lowering your torso while extending the opposite leg straight back, keeping the dumbbells close to your body, then reverse the motion to return to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, weight on one leg.
Keep a slight bend in your standing knee to stabilize your balance.
Hinge at your hips, lowering your torso while extending your other leg straight back.
Keep the dumbbells close to your body and your back flat throughout.
Reverse the motion, driving your hips forward to return to standing, then switch legs.

Standing Leg Curls.instructions: Stand facing the leg curl machine with the pad positioned against the back of one ankle. Curl your leg upward by bending your knee, bringing your heel toward your glute, then lower back down with control before switching legs.
instruction_steps: Stand facing the machine and position the ankle pad against the back of one ankle.
Hold the machine or handles for balance and keep your standing leg slightly bent.
Curl your working leg upward, bringing your heel toward your glute.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your hamstring.
Lower back down with control and repeat before switching legs.

Straight Leg Deadlift.instructions: Stand holding a barbell or dumbbells in front of your thighs with your knees nearly straight. Hinge at your hips, lowering the weight down your legs while keeping your back flat, until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings, then drive your hips forward to stand back up.
instruction_steps: Stand holding the weight in front of your thighs with your knees nearly straight.
Hinge at your hips, pushing them back as you lower the weight along your legs.
Keep your back flat and the weight close to your body throughout.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.

Chin Up.instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip, arms fully extended. Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar, then lower back down with control until your arms are straight.
instruction_steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an underhand grip, arms fully extended.
Engage your shoulders and brace your core.
Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control until your arms are fully straight, then repeat.

Chin Up (Assisted).instructions: Use an assisted pull-up machine or resistance band to support part of your bodyweight. Grip the bar with an underhand grip and pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Set the assistance level on the machine or loop a band around the bar.
Grip the bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Chin Up (Weighted).instructions: Attach additional weight via a belt or hold a dumbbell between your feet, then grip the bar with an underhand grip. Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a weight plate to a dip belt or secure a dumbbell between your feet.
Grip the bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control until your arms are straight, then repeat.

Dumbbell Row.instructions: Place one knee and hand on a bench for support, holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand with your arm extended. Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Place one knee and hand on a bench, back flat and parallel to the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand, arm extended toward the floor.
Pull the dumbbell up toward your hip, leading with your elbow.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Lower the dumbbell back down with control and repeat, then switch sides.

Iso-Lateral High Row (Machine).instructions: Sit in the iso-lateral high row machine with your chest against the pad, gripping each handle independently overhead. Pull both handles down and back toward your torso, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat and rest your chest against the pad.
Grip each handle independently above your head.
Pull both handles down and back toward your torso.
Pause briefly at full contraction, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Kipping Pull Up.instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar and generate momentum by swinging your body in a coordinated hip and shoulder motion, using the swing to help drive your chin over the bar, then lower back down and reset the swing for the next rep.
instruction_steps: Hang from the bar and begin swinging your body slightly, hips leading.
Drive your hips forward and shoulders back to generate momentum.
Use the momentum to pull your chin over the bar.
Push down and away from the bar to begin the descent.
Reset the swing rhythm and repeat for the desired repetitions.

Kneeling Pulldown (band).instructions: Kneel facing an anchored resistance band above your head, gripping the handles or band ends. Pull the band down toward your chest by driving your elbows down and back, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Anchor a resistance band overhead and kneel facing the anchor point.
Grip the band with both hands, arms extended overhead.
Pull the band down toward your chest, driving your elbows down and back.
Pause briefly at full contraction, squeezing your lats.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Lat Pulldown (Band).instructions: Anchor a resistance band overhead and sit or kneel facing it, gripping the band with a wide overhand grip. Pull the band down toward your chest, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Anchor a resistance band overhead and sit or kneel facing it.
Grip the band with a wide overhand grip, arms extended.
Pull the band down toward your upper chest, elbows driving down and back.
Pause briefly at full contraction, squeezing your lats.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Lat Pulldown (Cable).instructions: Sit at the lat pulldown machine with your thighs secured under the pad, gripping the bar with a wide overhand grip. Pull the bar down toward your upper chest, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Sit at the machine with your thighs secured under the pad.
Grip the bar with a wide overhand grip, arms extended overhead.
Pull the bar down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Pause briefly at full contraction, squeezing your lats.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position and repeat.

Lat Pulldown (Machine).instructions: Sit in the lat pulldown machine with your thighs secured, gripping the handles overhead. Pull the handles down toward your chest against the resistance, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Adjust the machine and sit with your thighs secured.
Grip the handles overhead with arms extended.
Pull the handles down toward your chest, driving your elbows down.
Pause briefly at full contraction, squeezing your lats.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Lat Pulldown - Close Grip (Cable).instructions: Sit at the lat pulldown machine gripping a close, neutral-grip handle attachment. Pull the handle down toward your upper chest, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Sit at the machine with your thighs secured under the pad.
Attach a close, neutral-grip handle and grip it with both hands.
Pull the handle down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Pause briefly at full contraction, squeezing your lats.
Slowly return the handle to the starting position and repeat.

Negative Pull Up.instructions: Jump or step up to the top position of a pull-up with your chin over the bar. Slowly lower your body down for a count of several seconds until your arms are fully extended, then reset and repeat.
instruction_steps: Use a box or jump to get your chin above the bar.
Grip the bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
Slowly lower your body down over several seconds.
Continue until your arms are fully extended.
Reset to the top position and repeat for the desired repetitions.

Pull Up.instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip, arms fully extended. Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar, then lower back down with control until your arms are straight.
instruction_steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms fully extended.
Engage your shoulders and brace your core.
Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control until your arms are fully straight, then repeat.

Pull Up (Assisted).instructions: Use an assisted pull-up machine or resistance band to support part of your bodyweight. Grip the bar with an overhand grip and pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Set the assistance level on the machine or loop a band around the bar.
Grip the bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Pull Up (Band).instructions: Loop a resistance band around the pull-up bar and place your knee or foot in the loop. Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Loop a resistance band around the pull-up bar.
Place one knee or foot into the bottom of the band loop.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip and pull your body upward.
Continue until your chin clears the bar.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Pull Up (Weighted).instructions: Attach additional weight via a belt or hold a dumbbell between your feet, then grip the bar with an overhand grip. Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a weight plate to a dip belt or secure a dumbbell between your feet.
Grip the bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control until your arms are straight, then repeat.

Pullover (Dumbbell).instructions: Lie perpendicular on a bench with only your upper back supported, holding a dumbbell above your chest with both hands. Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until you feel a stretch, then pull it back up over your chest.
instruction_steps: Lie perpendicular on a bench with your upper back supported and hips low.
Hold a dumbbell above your chest with both hands, arms slightly bent.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until you feel a stretch.
Pull the dumbbell back up and over your chest using your lats.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Pullover (Machine).instructions: Sit in the pullover machine with your back against the pad, gripping the bar handles above your head. Pull the bar down in an arc toward your torso, contracting your lats, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the bar handles overhead with elbows on the pads.
Pull the bar down in an arc toward your torso.
Pause briefly at full contraction, squeezing your lats.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable).instructions: Sit at the lat pulldown machine gripping the bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip. Pull the bar down toward your upper chest, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Sit at the machine with your thighs secured under the pad.
Grip the bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Pull the bar down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Pause briefly at full contraction, squeezing your lats.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position and repeat.

Ring Pull Up.instructions: Hang from gymnastic rings set at an appropriate height, gripping one in each hand. Pull your body upward, allowing the rings to rotate naturally, until your chin clears the rings, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Hang from gymnastic rings with an overhand grip, arms fully extended.
Engage your shoulders and brace your core.
