Pull your body upward, letting the rings rotate as needed.
Continue until your chin clears the rings.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Rope Straight Arm Pulldown.instructions: Stand facing a high cable pulley holding a rope attachment with straight arms. Pull the rope downward in an arc toward your thighs, keeping your arms straight, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing the machine.
Grip the rope with both hands, arms extended overhead.
Pull the rope down in an arc toward your thighs, keeping arms straight.
Pause briefly at full contraction, squeezing your lats.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Single Arm Lat Pulldown.instructions: Sit at a cable machine gripping a single handle attachment overhead with one hand. Pull the handle down toward your torso, then return slowly to the starting position, then switch sides.
instruction_steps: Sit at the machine and attach a single handle to a high pulley.
Grip the handle with one hand, arm extended overhead.
Pull the handle down toward your torso, driving your elbow down.
Pause briefly at full contraction, squeezing your lat.
Slowly return to the starting position, then switch arms after completing reps.

Sternum Pull up (Gironda).instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip. Pull yourself up while leaning your head back and arching your spine, aiming to touch your lower chest to the bar, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip.
Begin pulling up while driving your elbows down and back.
Lean your head back and arch your spine as you rise.
Continue until your lower chest touches the bar.
Lower back down with control, maintaining the arch, and repeat.

Straight Arm Lat Pulldown (Cable).instructions: Stand facing a high cable pulley holding a straight bar with straight arms. Pull the bar downward in an arc toward your thighs, keeping your arms straight, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and stand facing the machine.
Grip the bar with both hands, arms extended overhead.
Pull the bar down in an arc toward your thighs, keeping arms straight.
Pause briefly at full contraction, squeezing your lats.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Vertical Traction (Machine).instructions: Sit in the vertical traction machine with your thighs secured, gripping the handles overhead. Pull the handles down toward your chest against the resistance, then return slowly to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Adjust the machine and sit with your thighs secured.
Grip the handles overhead with arms extended.
Pull the handles down toward your chest, driving your elbows down.
Pause briefly at full contraction, squeezing your lats.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Wide Pull Up.instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a grip significantly wider than shoulder-width. Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar, then lower back down with control until your arms are straight.
instruction_steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a wide overhand grip.
Engage your shoulders and brace your core.
Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control until your arms are fully straight, then repeat.

Back Extension (Hyperextension).instructions: Position yourself face down on a hyperextension bench with your hips supported and ankles secured. Lower your torso forward by bending at the hips, then raise it back up to a straight line using your lower back and glutes.
instruction_steps: Position yourself on the hyperextension bench with hips on the pad.
Secure your ankles under the footpads.
Cross your arms over your chest and lower your torso forward.
Bend at the hips until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings and lower back.
Raise your torso back up to a straight line using your glutes and lower back.

Back Extension (Machine).instructions: Sit in the back extension machine with your torso against the pad and legs secured. Extend your torso backward against the resistance, then slowly return to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Adjust the machine and sit with your upper back against the pad.
Secure your legs and select an appropriate resistance.
Extend your torso backward against the resistance.
Pause briefly at full extension.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat.

Back Extension (Weighted Hyperextension).instructions: Position yourself face down on a hyperextension bench holding a weight plate against your chest. Lower your torso forward by bending at the hips, then raise it back up to a straight line using your lower back and glutes.
instruction_steps: Position yourself on the hyperextension bench with hips on the pad.
Hold a weight plate against your chest and secure your ankles.
Lower your torso forward until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Raise your torso back up to a straight line using your glutes and lower back.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Superman.instructions: Lie face down on the floor with your arms extended overhead and legs straight. Simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor, contracting your lower back and glutes, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Lie face down with arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Brace your lower back and glutes.
Simultaneously lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor.
Hold briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Lying Neck Curls.instructions: Lie on your back with your head hanging off the edge of a bench. Curl your chin toward your chest by contracting your neck flexors, then slowly lower your head back down.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back on a bench with your head extending off the edge.
Let your head drop back gently into a stretched position.
Curl your chin toward your chest using your neck muscles.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your head back down and repeat.

Lying Neck Curls (Weighted).instructions: Lie on your back with your head hanging off the edge of a bench, holding a light weight plate against your forehead. Curl your chin toward your chest, then slowly lower your head back down.
instruction_steps: Lie on your back on a bench with your head extending off the edge.
Hold a light weight plate securely against your forehead.
Curl your chin toward your chest using your neck muscles.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your head back down and repeat.

Lying Neck Extension.instructions: Lie face down with your head hanging off the edge of a bench. Extend your neck to raise your head upward, then slowly lower it back down to the stretched position.
instruction_steps: Lie face down on a bench with your head extending off the edge.
Let your head drop forward gently into a stretched position.
Extend your neck to raise your head upward.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your head back down and repeat.

Lying Neck Extension (Weighted).instructions: Lie face down with your head hanging off the edge of a bench, holding a light weight plate against the back of your head. Extend your neck to raise your head upward, then slowly lower it back down.
instruction_steps: Lie face down on a bench with your head extending off the edge.
Hold a light weight plate securely against the back of your head.
Extend your neck to raise your head upward.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your head back down and repeat.

Stretching.instructions: Move slowly into the target stretch position until you feel mild tension, not pain, then hold the position while breathing steadily. Gradually deepen the stretch as your muscles relax, holding for the desired duration.
instruction_steps: Move gently into the target stretch position.
Stop once you feel mild tension in the muscle.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Gradually deepen the stretch as your muscles relax.
Hold for the desired duration, then release slowly.

Assisted Pistol Squats.instructions: Stand on one leg holding a support like a rack or TRX for assistance, extending the other leg in front of you. Squat down as low as possible on the standing leg, using the support to assist your balance and strength, then stand back up.
instruction_steps: Stand on one leg, holding a sturdy support for assistance.
Extend your other leg straight out in front of you.
Squat down as low as possible, using the support to assist.
Keep your chest upright and heel planted throughout.
Drive back up to standing and repeat, then switch legs.

Belt Squat (Machine).instructions: Stand on the belt squat machine platform with a belt attached around your hips connected to the weight. Squat down by bending your knees and hips, then drive back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Attach the belt around your hips and stand on the platform.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest upright.
Descend until your thighs are roughly parallel to the platform.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Box Jump.instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder-width apart. Bend your knees and swing your arms back, then explosively jump onto the box, landing softly with bent knees, before stepping back down.
instruction_steps: Stand facing the box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back to load the jump.
Explosively jump onto the box, driving your arms forward.
Land softly on the box with bent knees, fully standing up.
Step back down and reset for the next repetition.

Box Squat (Barbell).instructions: Stand with a barbell across your upper back, a box or bench positioned behind you. Squat down until you lightly sit on the box, then drive back up through your heels to standing without relaxing at the bottom.
instruction_steps: Position a barbell across your upper back with a box behind you.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, box positioned at squat depth.
Squat down with control until you lightly touch the box.
Keep your core braced without fully sitting or relaxing.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Bulgarian Split Squat.instructions: Stand a couple feet in front of a bench with one foot resting on it behind you. Lower your body by bending your front knee until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then drive through your front heel to stand back up.
instruction_steps: Stand a couple feet in front of a bench, one foot resting on it behind you.
Keep your torso upright and front foot flat on the floor.
Lower your body by bending your front knee.
Descend until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up and repeat, then switch legs.

Curtsy Lunge (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand. Step one leg diagonally behind and across your body into a curtsy position, bending both knees, then push through your front heel to return to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step one leg diagonally behind and across your body.
Bend both knees, lowering your hips toward the floor.
Keep your front knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your front heel to return to standing, then switch legs.

Dumbbell Step Up.instructions: Stand in front of a bench or box holding a dumbbell in each hand. Step one foot onto the platform and drive through that heel to stand fully on top, then step back down with control and repeat.
instruction_steps: Stand in front of a sturdy bench or box holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place one foot fully on the platform.
Drive through that heel to stand up on the platform.
Bring your other foot up to stand fully upright.
Step back down with control and repeat, alternating legs.

Frog Jumps.instructions: Squat down into a low position with your hands touching the floor between your feet. Explosively jump forward, landing softly back into the squat position, then repeat continuously.
instruction_steps: Squat down low with your hands touching the floor between your feet.
Brace your core and prepare to jump forward.
Explosively jump forward, swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly back into the low squat position.
Continue jumping forward for the desired repetitions or distance.

Front Squat.instructions: Rack a barbell across the front of your shoulders with elbows raised high, feet shoulder-width apart. Squat down by bending your knees and hips while keeping your torso upright, then drive back up through your heels.
instruction_steps: Rack the bar across the front of your shoulders, elbows raised high.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your torso upright.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Full Squat.instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Squat down as deep as your mobility allows, keeping your chest upright and heels planted, then drive back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Brace your core and begin lowering your hips back and down.
Descend as deep as your mobility allows while keeping heels planted.
Keep your chest upright throughout the descent.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Goblet Squat.instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell or kettlebell vertically against your chest with both hands. Squat down by bending your knees and hips while keeping your torso upright, then drive back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes turned out.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest upright.
Descend until your elbows lightly touch the inside of your knees.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Hack Squat.instructions: Stand with a barbell held behind your legs, or use the hack squat position, feet shoulder-width apart. Squat down by bending your knees while keeping your torso upright, then drive back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the bar behind your legs if using a barbell.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips.
Descend until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Hack Squat (Machine).instructions: Position yourself in the hack squat machine with your shoulders under the pads and feet on the platform. Squat down by bending your knees, then drive through your heels to extend your legs back to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Position your shoulders under the pads and feet on the platform.
Release the safety handles and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down by bending your knees, keeping your back against the pad.
Descend until your thighs are roughly parallel to the platform.
Drive through your heels to extend your legs back up and repeat.

Jump Squat.instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back. Jump explosively off the ground, extending your hips, knees, and ankles. While in mid-air, quickly bring your arms forward for balance. Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next repetition. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Jump explosively off the ground, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
While in mid-air, quickly bring your arms forward for balance.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Jumping Lunge.instructions: Start in a lunge position with one foot forward and one back. Jump explosively, switching your leg positions in midair, and land softly back into a lunge with the opposite leg forward.
instruction_steps: Start in a lunge position with one foot forward and one back.
Bend both knees to about 90 degrees.
Jump explosively, swinging your arms and switching leg positions in the air.
Land softly into a lunge with the opposite leg forward.
Continue alternating legs for the desired repetitions.

Kettlebell Goblet Squat.instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell close to your chest with both hands. Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down into a squat position by bending at the knees and hips. Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell close to your chest with both hands.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down into a squat position by bending at the knees and hips.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Lateral Box Jump.instructions: Stand sideways next to a sturdy box with feet shoulder-width apart. Bend your knees and jump sideways onto the box, landing softly, then step or jump back down and repeat.
instruction_steps: Stand sideways next to the box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and swing your arms to load the jump.
Jump sideways onto the box, landing softly with bent knees.
Stand fully upright on the box.
Step or jump back down and repeat, then switch direction.

Lateral Lunge.instructions: Stand with feet together. Step one leg out wide to the side and bend that knee to lower your hips, keeping the other leg straight, then push through the bent leg to return to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand with feet together, core braced.
Step one leg out wide to the side.
Bend that knee to lower your hips, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest upright and weight on the bent leg's heel.
Push through the bent leg to return to standing, then switch legs.

Lateral Squat.instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width. Shift your weight to one side, bending that knee while keeping the other leg straight, then push back to center and repeat on the other side.
instruction_steps: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width apart.
Shift your weight to one side, bending that knee.
Keep the opposite leg straight and both feet flat on the floor.
Keep your chest upright throughout the movement.
Push back to center and repeat, alternating sides.

Leg Extension (Machine).instructions: Sit in the leg extension machine with the pad resting against the front of your lower legs. Extend your legs upward until straight by contracting your quads, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the machine so the pad rests against your lower shins.
Grip the side handles for stability.
Extend your legs upward until straight, contracting your quads.
Pause briefly at full extension.
Lower your legs back down with control and repeat.

Leg Press (Machine).instructions: Sit in the leg press machine with your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform. Lower the platform by bending your knees toward your chest, then press back up through your heels to extend your legs.
instruction_steps: Sit in the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety handles and extend your legs to unrack the weight.
Lower the platform by bending your knees toward your chest.
Descend until your knees reach about a 90-degree angle.
Press through your heels to extend your legs back up and repeat.

Leg Press Horizontal (Machine).instructions: Sit in the horizontal leg press machine with your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform. Push the platform away by extending your legs, then bend your knees to return with control.
instruction_steps: Sit in the horizontal machine with feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Grip the side handles and extend your legs to unrack the weight.
Bend your knees to lower the platform toward your body.
Descend until your knees reach about a 90-degree angle.
Press through your heels to extend your legs back out and repeat.

Lunge.instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart. Step forward with one leg and lower your body until both knees are bent around 90 degrees, then push through your front heel to return to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, core braced.
Step forward with one leg.
Lower your body until both knees are bent around 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your front heel to return to standing, then switch legs.

Lunge (Barbell).instructions: Stand with a barbell across your upper back, feet hip-width apart. Step forward with one leg and lower your body until both knees are bent around 90 degrees, then push through your front heel to return to standing.
instruction_steps: Position a barbell across your upper back as in a squat setup.
Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Step forward with one leg and lower your body until both knees bend to about 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your front heel to return to standing, then switch legs.

Lunge (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, feet hip-width apart. Step forward with one leg and lower your body until both knees are bent around 90 degrees, then push through your front heel to return to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward with one leg.
Lower your body until both knees are bent around 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your front heel to return to standing, then switch legs.

Overhead Dumbbell Lunge.instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand locked out overhead, feet hip-width apart. Step forward with one leg and lower your body until both knees are bent, keeping the dumbbells overhead, then return to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand locked out overhead.
Brace your core to keep your torso upright.
Step forward with one leg and lower into a lunge.
Keep the dumbbells locked out overhead throughout.
Push through your front heel to return to standing, then switch legs.

Pause Squat (Barbell).instructions: Stand with a barbell across your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart. Squat down and pause for a couple seconds at the bottom position before driving back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Position a barbell across your upper back as in a standard squat setup.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Pause for a couple seconds at the bottom, maintaining tension.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Pendulum Squat (Machine).instructions: Position yourself in the pendulum squat machine with your shoulders under the pads and feet on the platform. Squat down by bending your knees as the platform arcs, then drive through your heels to extend back up.
instruction_steps: Position your shoulders under the pads and feet on the platform.
Release the safety mechanism and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down by bending your knees, following the machine's arc.
Descend until your thighs are roughly parallel to the platform.
Drive through your heels to extend your legs back up and repeat.

Pistol Squat.instructions: Stand on one leg with the other extended straight out in front of you. Squat down as low as possible on the standing leg while keeping your chest upright and the extended leg off the floor, then drive back up.
instruction_steps: Stand on one leg with the other extended straight in front of you.
Extend your arms forward for counterbalance.
Squat down as low as possible on the standing leg.
Keep your chest upright and the extended leg off the floor.
Drive back up to standing and repeat, then switch legs.

Reverse Lunge.instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart. Step backward with one leg and lower your body until both knees are bent around 90 degrees, then push through your front heel to return to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, core braced.
Step backward with one leg.
Lower your body until both knees are bent around 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your front heel to return to standing, then switch legs.

Reverse Lunge (Barbell).instructions: Stand with a barbell across your upper back, feet hip-width apart. Step backward with one leg and lower your body until both knees are bent around 90 degrees, then push through your front heel to return to standing.
instruction_steps: Position a barbell across your upper back as in a squat setup.
Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Step backward with one leg and lower your body until both knees bend to about 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your front heel to return to standing, then switch legs.

Reverse Lunge (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, feet hip-width apart. Step backward with one leg and lower your body until both knees are bent around 90 degrees, then push through your front heel to return to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step backward with one leg.
Lower your body until both knees are bent around 90 degrees.
Keep your front knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your front heel to return to standing, then switch legs.

Single Leg Extensions.instructions: Sit in the leg extension machine with the pad resting against the front of one lower leg. Extend that leg upward until straight by contracting your quad, then lower back down with control before switching legs.
instruction_steps: Adjust the machine so the pad rests against one lower shin.
Grip the side handles for stability.
Extend that leg upward until straight, contracting your quad.
Pause briefly at full extension.
Lower your leg back down with control, then switch legs after your reps.

Single Leg Press (Machine).instructions: Sit in the leg press machine with one foot centered on the platform. Lower the platform by bending your knee toward your chest, then press back up through your heel to extend your leg.
instruction_steps: Sit in the machine with one foot centered on the platform.
Release the safety handles and extend your leg to unrack the weight.
Lower the platform by bending your knee toward your chest.
Descend until your knee reaches about a 90-degree angle.
Press through your heel to extend your leg back up, then switch legs.

Sissy Squat (Weighted).instructions: Stand holding a weight against your chest, securing your feet or using a support for balance. Lean back and bend your knees, dropping your hips while keeping your torso straight, until you feel a deep quad stretch, then rise back up.
instruction_steps: Secure your feet or hold a support for balance, weight against your chest.
Rise onto the balls of your feet if possible.
Bend your knees, leaning your torso back while keeping it straight.
Descend until you feel a deep stretch in your quads.
Contract your quads to rise back to standing and repeat.

Split Squat (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand in a staggered stance holding a dumbbell in each hand, both feet remaining on the floor. Lower your body by bending both knees until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then drive through your front heel to stand back up.
instruction_steps: Stand in a staggered stance with one foot forward, holding dumbbells at your sides.
Keep both feet flat on the floor throughout the movement.
Lower your body by bending both knees.
Descend until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Drive through your front heel to stand back up and repeat, then switch legs.

Squat (Band).instructions: Stand on a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the handles at your shoulders. Squat down by bending your knees and hips, then drive back up through your heels against the band's resistance.
instruction_steps: Stand on the middle of a resistance band with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handles at your shoulders.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest upright.
Descend until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up against the band and repeat.

Squat (Barbell).instructions: Stand with a barbell across your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart. Squat down by bending your knees and hips while keeping your torso upright, then drive back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Position a barbell across your upper back with a secure grip.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest upright.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Squat (Bodyweight).instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hands extended in front of you or crossed at your chest. Squat down by bending your knees and hips while keeping your torso upright, then drive back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Extend your arms forward for balance.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest upright.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Squat (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, feet shoulder-width apart. Squat down by bending your knees and hips while keeping your torso upright, then drive back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest upright.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Squat (Machine).instructions: Position yourself in the squat machine with your shoulders or hips secured according to the machine design. Squat down by bending your knees against the resistance, then drive back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Position yourself in the machine according to its design.
Select an appropriate resistance and secure your stance.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips.
Descend until your thighs are roughly parallel to the platform.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Squat (Smith Machine).instructions: Stand under a Smith machine bar positioned across your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart. Unrack the bar, squat down by bending your knees and hips, then drive back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Position the Smith machine bar across your upper back.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and unrack the bar.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest upright.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Squat (Suspension).instructions: Hold the suspension trainer handles for balance, feet shoulder-width apart. Squat down by bending your knees and hips while leaning back slightly into the straps, then drive back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Hold the suspension trainer handles with arms extended in front of you.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips, leaning back slightly into the straps.
Descend until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Step Up.instructions: Stand in front of a bench or box. Step one foot onto the platform and drive through that heel to stand fully on top, then step back down with control and repeat, alternating legs.
instruction_steps: Stand in front of a sturdy bench or box.
Place one foot fully on the platform.
Drive through that heel to stand up on the platform.
Bring your other foot up to stand fully upright.
Step back down with control and repeat, alternating legs.

Sumo Squat.instructions: Stand with a wide stance, toes pointed outward. Squat down by bending your knees and hips while keeping your torso upright, then drive back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand with a wide stance, toes pointed outward.
Brace your core and keep your chest upright.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips.
Descend until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Sumo Squat (Barbell).instructions: Stand with a wide stance and a barbell across your upper back, toes pointed outward. Squat down by bending your knees and hips while keeping your torso upright, then drive back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Position a barbell across your upper back with a secure grip.
Stand with a wide stance, toes pointed outward.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest upright.
Descend until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Sumo Squat (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand with a wide stance holding a dumbbell vertically between your legs, toes pointed outward. Squat down by bending your knees and hips, then drive back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand with a wide stance, toes pointed outward.
Hold a dumbbell vertically with both hands between your legs.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest upright.
Descend until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Sumo Squat (Kettlebell).instructions: Stand with a wide stance holding a kettlebell with both hands between your legs, toes pointed outward. Squat down by bending your knees and hips, then drive back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Stand with a wide stance, toes pointed outward.
Hold a kettlebell with both hands between your legs.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest upright.
Descend until your thighs are roughly parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Walking Lunge.instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Take a step forward with your right leg, lowering your body into a lunge position. Keep your torso upright and your front knee aligned with your ankle. Push off with your right foot and bring your left foot forward, stepping into a lunge position with your left leg. Continue alternating legs and walking forward, maintaining a controlled and steady pace. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right leg, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee aligned with your ankle.
Push off with your right foot and bring your left foot forward, stepping into a lunge position with your left leg.
Continue alternating legs and walking forward, maintaining a controlled and steady pace.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Walking Lunge (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand. Step forward into a lunge, then instead of stepping back, bring your rear foot forward to step into the next lunge, continuing to walk forward.
instruction_steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward with one leg into a lunge position.
Lower until both knees are bent around 90 degrees.
Drive through your front heel and bring your rear foot forward to standing.
Continue stepping forward, alternating legs, for the desired distance.

Wall Sit.instructions: Stand with your back against a wall and slide down until your knees are bent at roughly 90 degrees, thighs parallel to the floor. Hold this position, keeping your back flat against the wall, for the desired duration.
instruction_steps: Stand with your back flat against a wall.
Slide down until your knees are bent at roughly 90 degrees.
Keep your thighs parallel to the floor and back against the wall.
Hold the position, breathing steadily.
Slide back up to standing once the duration is complete.

Zercher Squat.instructions: Hold a barbell in the crooks of your elbows against your torso, feet shoulder-width apart. Squat down by bending your knees and hips while keeping your torso upright, then drive back up through your heels to standing.
instruction_steps: Cradle a barbell in the crooks of your elbows, held against your torso.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest upright.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up and repeat.

Arnold Press (Dumbbell).instructions: Sit or stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with your palms facing you. Press the dumbbells overhead while rotating your palms to face forward, then reverse the rotation as you lower back down to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing your body.
Brace your core and begin pressing the dumbbells upward.
Rotate your palms to face forward as you press to full extension overhead.
Pause briefly at the top with arms locked out.
Reverse the rotation as you lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.

Band Pullaparts.instructions: Hold a resistance band with both hands in front of your chest, arms extended and shoulder-width apart. Pull the band apart by drawing your arms out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Hold the band with both hands, arms extended in front of your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout the movement.
Pull the band apart by drawing your arms out to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Chest Supported Reverse Fly (Dumbbell).instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down. Raise your arms out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Lie face down on an incline bench, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they're roughly in line with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control and repeat.

Chest Supported Y Raise (Dumbbell).instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a light dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down. Raise your arms upward and outward to form a Y shape, thumbs pointing up, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Lie face down on an incline bench, holding a light dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down, thumbs rotated slightly upward.
Raise your arms upward and outward at roughly a 30-degree angle to form a Y shape.
Pause briefly at the top, squeezing your upper back and rear shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control and repeat.

Face Pull.instructions: Attach a rope to a cable pulley set at upper chest height and grip it with both hands, palms facing each other. Pull the rope toward your face, flaring your elbows out and back while squeezing your shoulder blades together, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a rope to a cable set at roughly chest or head height.
Grip the rope ends with both hands, palms facing each other.
Step back to create tension, then pull the rope toward your face.
Flare your elbows out and back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Front Raise (Band).instructions: Stand on a resistance band with feet hip-width apart, holding the handles in front of your thighs. Raise your arms straight out in front of you to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart, holding a handle in each hand.
Let your arms hang in front of your thighs with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise your arms straight out in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulders.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Front Raise (Barbell).instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip in front of your thighs. Raise the bar straight out in front of you to shoulder height, keeping your arms mostly straight, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand holding the barbell with an overhand grip in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and brace your core.
Raise the bar straight out in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without leaning back or shrugging.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Front Raise (Cable).instructions: Stand facing away from a low cable pulley, holding the handle in front of your thighs. Raise your arm straight out in front of you to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in the elbow, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a handle to a low pulley and stand facing away from the machine.
Hold the handle in front of your thigh with a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm straight out in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulder.
Lower back down with control and repeat before switching arms.

Front Raise (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs. Raise one or both dumbbells straight out in front of you to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and brace your core.
Raise the dumbbells straight out in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without leaning back or shrugging.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Front Raise (Suspension).instructions: Hold the suspension trainer handles and lean back with your body straight and arms extended in front of you. Keeping your body rigid, raise your torso by pulling the handles down toward your thighs, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Hold the suspension trainer handles with arms extended in front of you.
Lean back with your body straight, feet planted, and core braced.
Keeping your arms extended, pull down through the straps to raise your torso.
Pause briefly with your body more upright.
Return to the leaned-back starting position with control and repeat.

Handstand Push Up.instructions: Kick up into a handstand against a wall with your hands shoulder-width apart on the floor. Lower your body by bending your elbows until your head nearly touches the floor, then press back up to full arm extension.
instruction_steps: Kick up into a handstand against a wall, hands shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your body straight and rigid.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your head nearly touches the floor.
Pause briefly at the bottom without resting your head down.
Press through your hands to return to full arm extension and repeat.

Kettlebell Around the World.instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell by the horns with both hands in front of your body. Pass the kettlebell around your waist in a circular motion, switching hands behind your back, keeping your core braced throughout.
instruction_steps: Stand holding the kettlebell by the horns in front of your waist.
Brace your core and keep your knees slightly bent for stability.
Pass the kettlebell around your waist, switching hands behind your back.
Continue circling in one direction for the desired repetitions.
Reverse direction and repeat the circular motion the other way.

Kettlebell Halo.instructions: Stand holding a kettlebell by the horns close to your chest. Circle the kettlebell around your head, passing it from one hand position to the other behind your neck, keeping your core braced and torso upright throughout.
instruction_steps: Stand holding the kettlebell by the horns close to your chest.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Circle the kettlebell around your head, passing it close to your skull.
Continue circling in one direction for the desired repetitions.
Reverse direction and repeat the circular motion the other way.

Kettlebell Shoulder Press.instructions: Hold a kettlebell in the rack position at one shoulder, elbow tucked in front of your body. Press the kettlebell straight overhead until your arm is fully extended, then lower back down to the rack position with control.
instruction_steps: Hold the kettlebell in the rack position at your shoulder, elbow down.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Press the kettlebell straight overhead until your arm is fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top with the kettlebell stable overhead.
Lower back down to the rack position with control and repeat.

Lateral Raise (Band).instructions: Stand on a resistance band with feet hip-width apart, holding the handles at your sides. Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart, holding a handle in each hand.
Let your arms hang at your sides with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulders.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Lateral Raise (Cable).instructions: Stand sideways to a low cable pulley, holding the handle with the arm farthest from the machine. Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in the elbow, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a handle to a low pulley and stand sideways to the machine.
Hold the handle with the arm farthest from the machine, across your body.
Raise your arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulder.
Lower back down with control and repeat, then switch sides.

Lateral Raise (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout the movement.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulders.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Lateral Raise (Machine).instructions: Sit in the lateral raise machine with your arms against the pads and elbows bent. Raise your arms out to the sides against the resistance until they reach shoulder height, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat and position your arms against the pads with elbows bent.
Sit tall and brace your core against the backrest.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulders.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Overhead Plate Raise.instructions: Stand holding a weight plate with both hands in front of your thighs. Raise the plate overhead in a straight arm motion, keeping your core braced, then lower back down with control to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Stand holding the plate with both hands in front of your thighs.
Brace your core and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the plate overhead in a straight arc, keeping your arms extended.
Pause briefly at the top with the plate stable overhead.
Lower back down with control to the starting position and repeat.

Overhead Press (Barbell).instructions: Stand holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip, elbows slightly in front of the bar. Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are fully extended, then lower back down to shoulder height with control.
instruction_steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the bar at shoulder height.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to stabilize your torso.
Press the bar straight overhead, moving your head back slightly to clear it.
Lock your arms out at the top with the bar over your midline.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

Overhead Press (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand or sit holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height. Press the dumbbells straight overhead until your arms are fully extended, then lower back down to shoulder height with control.
instruction_steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Press the dumbbells straight overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top with the dumbbells stable overhead.
Lower back down to shoulder height with control and repeat.

Overhead Press (Smith Machine).instructions: Sit or stand under the Smith machine bar with it positioned at shoulder height. Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are fully extended, then lower back down to shoulder height with control.
instruction_steps: Position yourself under the bar with it set at shoulder height.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width and unrack it.
Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top with the bar locked out.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

Pike Pushup.instructions: Start in a downward dog position with your hips raised high and hands shoulder-width apart on the floor. Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor, then press back up to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Start in a downward dog position, hips raised and hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your legs mostly straight and your weight shifted over your hands.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Pause briefly at the bottom without touching your head down.
Press through your hands to return to the starting position and repeat.

Plate Front Raise.instructions: Stand holding a weight plate with both hands in front of your thighs. Raise the plate straight out in front of you to shoulder height, keeping your arms mostly straight, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand holding the plate with both hands in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and brace your core.
Raise the plate straight out in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without leaning back.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Push Press.instructions: Stand holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip. Dip slightly by bending your knees, then drive upward explosively, using the leg drive to help press the bar overhead to full lockout, then lower back down to shoulder height.
instruction_steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the bar at shoulder height.
Take a short, controlled dip by bending your knees slightly.
Drive upward explosively through your legs.
Use the momentum to press the bar overhead to full lockout.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Cable).instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with the pulleys set at chest height, crossing your arms to grip the opposite handles. Pull the handles out and back, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Set both cable pulleys to roughly chest height and grip the opposite handles with crossed arms.
Stand facing the machine with a slight bend in your knees.
Pull the handles out and back, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Dumbbell).instructions: Hinge forward at your hips holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down. Raise your arms out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Hinge forward at your hips, holding a dumbbell in each hand, back flat.
Let your arms hang straight down with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they're roughly in line with your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control and repeat.

Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Machine).instructions: Sit facing the machine with your chest against the pad and arms gripping the handles in front of you. Pull your arms out and back, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat and sit facing the machine with your chest against the pad.
Grip the handles in front of you with a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull your arms out and back in an arcing motion.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Reverse Fly Single Arm (Cable).instructions: Stand sideways to a cable pulley set at chest height, gripping the handle with the arm farthest from the machine. Pull the handle out and back across your body, squeezing your shoulder blade, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Set the cable pulley to chest height and stand sideways to the machine.
Grip the handle with the arm farthest from the machine, reaching across your body.
Pull the handle out and back, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end of the movement.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat, then switch sides.

Seated Lateral Raise (Dumbbell).instructions: Sit on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Sit tall on a bench, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout the movement.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulders.
Lower back down with control and repeat.

Seated Overhead Press (Barbell).instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip. Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are fully extended, then lower back down to shoulder height with control.
instruction_steps: Sit on a bench with back support, holding the bar at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep your back flat against the support.
Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top with the bar over your midline.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

Seated Overhead Press (Dumbbell).instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height. Press the dumbbells straight overhead until your arms are fully extended, then lower back down to shoulder height with control.
instruction_steps: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep your back flat against the support.
Press the dumbbells straight overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top with the dumbbells stable overhead.
Lower back down to shoulder height with control and repeat.

Seated Shoulder Press (Machine).instructions: Sit in the shoulder press machine with your back against the pad and hands gripping the handles at shoulder height. Press the handles straight overhead until your arms are fully extended, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat so the handles align with your shoulders.
Sit with your back against the pad and grip the handles.
Press the handles straight overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top without locking your elbows harshly.
Lower back down with control to the starting position and repeat.

Shoulder Press (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand or sit holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height. Press the dumbbells straight overhead until your arms are fully extended, then lower back down to shoulder height with control.
instruction_steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and keep your torso stable.
Press the dumbbells straight overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top with the dumbbells stable overhead.
Lower back down to shoulder height with control and repeat.

Shoulder Press (Machine Plates).instructions: Sit in the plate-loaded shoulder press machine with your back against the pad and hands gripping the handles at shoulder height. Press the handles straight overhead until your arms are fully extended, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat so the handles align with your shoulders.
Sit with your back against the pad and grip the handles firmly.
Press the handles straight overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause briefly at the top without locking your elbows harshly.
Lower back down with control to the starting position and repeat.

Shoulder Taps.instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands under your shoulders and feet slightly wider than hip-width. Tap one hand to the opposite shoulder while keeping your hips as stable as possible, then return it to the floor and switch sides.
instruction_steps: Start in a high plank position, hands under shoulders and feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Brace your core to keep your hips level and stable.
Lift one hand and tap it to the opposite shoulder.
Return the hand to the floor without letting your hips rotate.
Repeat with the other hand, alternating sides continuously.

Single Arm Landmine Press (Barbell).instructions: Hold the end of a landmine barbell at shoulder height with one hand, standing in a staggered stance. Press the bar forward and upward along its natural arc until your arm is fully extended, then lower back down to your shoulder with control.
instruction_steps: Hold the landmine bar at your shoulder with one hand, standing in a staggered stance.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Press the bar forward and upward along its natural arc.
Extend your arm fully at the top of the movement.
Lower the bar back to your shoulder with control and repeat, then switch arms.

Single Arm Lateral Raise (Cable).instructions: Stand sideways to a low cable pulley, holding the handle with the arm farthest from the machine. Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height, keeping a slight bend in your elbow, then lower back down with control before switching sides.
instruction_steps: Attach a handle to a low pulley and stand sideways to the machine.
Hold the handle with the arm farthest from the machine, across your body.
Raise your arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging your shoulder.
Lower back down with control and repeat, then switch sides.

Standing Military Press (Barbell).instructions: Stand holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip, feet shoulder-width apart. Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are fully extended, keeping your core braced, then lower back down to shoulder height with control.
instruction_steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding the bar at shoulder height.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes to keep your torso rigid.
Press the bar straight overhead, moving your head back slightly to clear it.
Lock your arms out at the top with the bar over your midline.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

Upright Row (Barbell).instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip in front of your thighs, hands shoulder-width apart. Pull the bar straight up toward your chin, leading with your elbows, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand holding the barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Pull the bar straight up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Raise your elbows above your wrists at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control to the starting position and repeat.

Upright Row (Cable).instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley, holding the bar or rope attachment in front of your thighs. Pull the attachment straight up toward your chin, leading with your elbows, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a bar or rope to a low pulley and stand facing the machine.
Grip the attachment with hands shoulder-width apart, in front of your thighs.
Pull the attachment straight up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Raise your elbows above your wrists at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control to the starting position and repeat.

Upright Row (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs. Pull the dumbbells straight up toward your chin, leading with your elbows, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Brace your core and keep the dumbbells close to your body.
Pull the dumbbells straight up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Raise your elbows above your wrists at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control to the starting position and repeat.

Shrug (Barbell).instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip. Elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as possible, then lower them back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a barbell with an overhand grip in front of your thighs.
Keep your arms straight throughout the movement.
Elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your shoulders back down with control and repeat.

Shrug (Cable).instructions: Stand in front of a low cable pulley holding the bar attachment in front of your thighs. Elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as possible, then lower them back down with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand facing the machine.
Grip the bar in front of your thighs with arms straight.
Elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your shoulders back down with control and repeat.

Shrug (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as possible, then lower them back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep your arms straight throughout the movement.
Elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your shoulders back down with control and repeat.

Shrug (Machine).instructions: Sit or stand in the shrug machine gripping the handles. Elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears against the resistance, then lower them back down with control.
instruction_steps: Position yourself in the machine and grip the handles.
Select an appropriate resistance.
Elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your shoulders back down with control and repeat.

Shrug (Smith Machine).instructions: Stand under a Smith machine bar set at hip height, gripping it with an overhand grip. Unrack the bar, then elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears, and lower them back down with control.
instruction_steps: Set the Smith machine bar at hip height and grip it with an overhand grip.
Unrack the bar and stand upright, arms straight.
Elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your shoulders back down with control and repeat.

Bench Dip.instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands gripping the edge next to your hips and legs extended in front of you. Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor, then press back up to full arm extension.
instruction_steps: Sit on the edge of a bench with hands gripping the edge next to your hips.
Extend your legs out in front of you, supporting your weight on your heels.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping them pointing backward.
Descend until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor.
Press through your hands to return to full arm extension and repeat.

Bench Press - Close Grip (Barbell).instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a barbell with a shoulder-width or slightly narrower grip. Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your body, then press it back up to full arm extension.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on the bench and grip the bar with hands shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and hold it directly over your chest with arms extended.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked close to your body.
Pause briefly when the bar lightly touches your chest.
Press the bar back up to full arm extension and repeat.

Diamond Push Up.instructions: Get into a push-up position with your hands close together under your chest, forming a diamond shape with your thumbs and index fingers. Lower your body by bending your elbows close to your sides, then press back up to full arm extension.
instruction_steps: Get into a push-up position with hands close together, forming a diamond shape.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your body by bending your elbows close to your sides.
Lower until your chest nearly touches your hands.
Press through your hands to return to full arm extension and repeat.

Floor Triceps Dip.instructions: Sit on the floor with your hands placed behind your hips, fingers pointing toward your body, and legs extended or knees bent. Lift your hips off the floor and lower your body by bending your elbows, then press back up to full arm extension.
instruction_steps: Sit on the floor with hands placed behind your hips, fingers pointing toward your body.
Lift your hips off the floor, supporting your weight on your hands and heels.
Lower your body by bending your elbows straight back.
Lower until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor.
Press through your hands to return to full arm extension and repeat.

JM Press (Barbell).instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a barbell with a shoulder-width grip, arms extended over your chest. Lower the bar toward your chin or upper chest by bending your elbows in a hybrid motion between a skullcrusher and close-grip press, then press it back up to full extension.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on the bench and grip the bar with hands shoulder-width apart.
Hold the bar with arms extended directly over your upper chest.
Lower the bar toward your chin or neck by bending your elbows, keeping them tucked.
Pause briefly near the bottom of the movement.
Press the bar back up to full arm extension and repeat.

Overhead Triceps Extension (Cable).instructions: Stand facing away from a low cable pulley with a rope attachment, holding it behind your head with elbows bent and pointing upward. Extend your arms overhead by straightening your elbows, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from the machine.
Hold the rope behind your head with elbows bent and pointing upward.
Keep your upper arms stationary and extend your forearms overhead.
Pause briefly at full extension, squeezing your triceps.
Lower back down with control to the starting position and repeat.

Seated Dip Machine.instructions: Sit in the dip machine with your hands gripping the handles at your sides. Press the handles downward by extending your elbows, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat and grip the handles at your sides.
Sit tall with your back against the pad.
Press the handles downward by extending your elbows.
Pause briefly at full extension, squeezing your triceps.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Seated Triceps Press.instructions: Sit on a bench holding a dumbbell with both hands behind your head, elbows pointing upward. Extend your arms overhead by straightening your elbows, then lower back down behind your head with control.
instruction_steps: Sit on a bench holding a dumbbell with both hands, positioned behind your head.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and elbows pointing upward.
Extend your arms overhead by straightening your elbows.
Pause briefly at full extension, squeezing your triceps.
Lower back down behind your head with control and repeat.

Single Arm Tricep Extension (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand or sit holding a dumbbell overhead with one arm, elbow pointing upward. Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbow, then extend your arm back to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Hold a dumbbell overhead with one arm, elbow pointing upward.
Keep your upper arm close to your ear and stationary throughout.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbow.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your triceps.
Extend your arm back to the starting position and repeat, then switch arms.

Single Arm Triceps Pushdown (Cable).instructions: Stand facing a high cable pulley with a single handle attachment, gripping it with one hand at chest height, elbow tucked to your side. Push the handle downward by extending your elbow, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and grip it with one hand.
Tuck your elbow to your side and keep your upper arm stationary.
Push the handle downward by extending your elbow to full extension.
Pause briefly at the bottom, squeezing your triceps.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat, then switch arms.

Skullcrusher (Barbell).instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a barbell with a shoulder-width grip, arms extended over your chest. Lower the bar toward your forehead by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary, then extend back up to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on the bench, holding the bar with arms extended over your chest.
Keep your upper arms stationary and perpendicular to the floor.
Lower the bar toward your forehead by bending your elbows.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your triceps.
Extend your arms back to the starting position and repeat.

Skullcrusher (Dumbbell).instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms extended over your chest. Lower the dumbbells toward your forehead by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary, then extend back up to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on the bench, holding a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Keep your upper arms stationary and perpendicular to the floor.
Lower the dumbbells toward your forehead by bending your elbows.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your triceps.
Extend your arms back to the starting position and repeat.

Triceps Dip.instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward. Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands. Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench. Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Triceps Dip (Assisted).instructions: Set the desired assistance level on an assisted dip machine and kneel or stand on the platform. Grip the handles and lower your body by bending your elbows, then press back up to full arm extension.
instruction_steps: Set the assistance weight on the machine and step onto the platform.
Grip the handles with your arms extended and body upright.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Descend until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor.
Press through your hands to return to full arm extension and repeat.

Triceps Dip (Weighted).instructions: Attach additional weight using a dip belt and grip the dip bars with your arms extended. Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides, then press back up to full arm extension.
instruction_steps: Attach a weighted dip belt and grip the dip bars with arms extended.
Keep your torso upright and elbows close to your body.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are roughly parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement.
Press through your hands to return to full arm extension and repeat.

Triceps Extension (Barbell).instructions: Stand or sit holding a barbell overhead with both hands, elbows pointing upward. Lower the bar behind your head by bending your elbows, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Hold the bar overhead with both hands, elbows pointing upward.
Keep your upper arms stationary and close to your ears.
Lower the bar behind your head by bending your elbows.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your triceps.
Extend your arms back to the starting position and repeat.

Triceps Extension (Cable).instructions: Stand facing a high cable pulley with a bar or rope attachment, gripping it at chest height with elbows tucked to your sides. Push the attachment downward by extending your elbows, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a bar or rope to a high pulley and grip it with both hands.
Tuck your elbows to your sides and keep your upper arms stationary.
Push the attachment downward by extending your elbows to full extension.
Pause briefly at the bottom, squeezing your triceps.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Triceps Extension (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand or sit holding a dumbbell overhead with both hands, elbows pointing upward. Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Hold the dumbbell overhead with both hands, elbows pointing upward.
Keep your upper arms stationary and close to your ears.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your triceps.
Extend your arms back to the starting position and repeat.

Triceps Extension (Machine).instructions: Sit in the triceps extension machine with your upper arms resting against the pad and hands gripping the handles. Push the handles downward or forward by extending your elbows, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat and rest your upper arms against the pad.
Grip the handles with your elbows bent at the starting position.
Extend your elbows to push the handles through the movement.
Pause briefly at full extension, squeezing your triceps.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Triceps Extension (Suspension).instructions: Hold the suspension trainer handles and lean forward with your body straight, arms extended and elbows pointing forward near your head. Bend your elbows to lower your body toward your hands, then extend back to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Hold the suspension trainer handles with arms extended overhead in front of you.
Lean forward with your body straight, feet planted, and core braced.
Bend your elbows to lower your body toward your hands.
Keep your upper arms stationary near your head throughout.
Extend your elbows to press back to the starting position and repeat.

Triceps Kickback (Cable).instructions: Stand facing a low cable pulley, holding the handle with one hand and hinging slightly forward at the hips, upper arm parallel to the floor. Extend your arm straight back by straightening your elbow, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a handle to a low pulley and stand facing the machine.
Hinge slightly forward at your hips, keeping your upper arm parallel to the floor.
Extend your arm straight back by straightening your elbow.
Pause briefly at full extension, squeezing your triceps.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat, then switch arms.

Triceps Kickback (Dumbbell).instructions: Hinge forward at your hips holding a dumbbell in one hand, upper arm parallel to the floor and elbow bent. Extend your arm straight back by straightening your elbow, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Hinge forward at your hips, holding a dumbbell with your upper arm parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbow bent at roughly 90 degrees at the starting position.
Extend your arm straight back by straightening your elbow.
Pause briefly at full extension, squeezing your triceps.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat, then switch arms.

Triceps Pressdown.instructions: Stand facing a high cable pulley with a bar attachment, gripping it at chest height with elbows tucked to your sides. Push the bar downward by extending your elbows, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a bar to a high pulley and grip it with both hands, palms facing down.
Tuck your elbows to your sides and keep your upper arms stationary.
Push the bar downward by extending your elbows to full extension.
Pause briefly at the bottom, squeezing your triceps.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Triceps Pushdown.instructions: Stand facing a high cable pulley with a bar or straight attachment, gripping it with an overhand grip at chest height, elbows tucked to your sides. Push the attachment downward by extending your elbows, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a bar to a high pulley and grip it with both hands, palms facing down.
Tuck your elbows to your sides and keep your upper arms stationary.
Push the bar downward by extending your elbows to full extension.
Pause briefly at the bottom, squeezing your triceps.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.
