Triceps Rope Pushdown.instructions: Stand facing a high cable pulley with a rope attachment, gripping it at chest height with elbows tucked to your sides. Push the rope downward by extending your elbows, spreading the rope apart at the bottom, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip both ends with your palms facing each other.
Tuck your elbows to your sides and keep your upper arms stationary.
Push the rope downward by extending your elbows, spreading the ends apart.
Pause briefly at the bottom, squeezing your triceps.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Wide-Elbow Triceps Press (Dumbbell).instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand over your chest, arms extended. Lower the dumbbells toward your chest while letting your elbows flare out wider than a standard press, then press back up to full arm extension.
instruction_steps: Lie flat on the bench, holding a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Extend your arms fully with the dumbbells positioned above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells toward your chest, allowing your elbows to flare outward.
Pause briefly near the bottom of the movement.
Press the dumbbells back up to full arm extension and repeat.

Bent Over Row (Band).instructions: Stand on a resistance band with feet hip-width apart, hinging forward at your hips while holding the handles. Pull the handles up toward your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart, gripping a handle in each hand.
Hinge forward at your hips, keeping your back flat and knees slightly bent.
Pull the handles up toward your waist, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control to the starting position and repeat.

Bent Over Row (Barbell).instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip, hinging forward at your hips until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor. Pull the bar up toward your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand holding the barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Hinge forward at your hips until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat and let the bar hang with arms extended.
Pull the bar up toward your lower ribs, leading with your elbows.
Lower back down with control to the starting position and repeat.

Bent Over Row (Dumbbell).instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, hinging forward at your hips until your torso is roughly parallel to the floor. Pull the dumbbells up toward your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, hinging forward at your hips.
Keep your back flat and let the dumbbells hang with arms extended.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your lower ribs, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control to the starting position and repeat.

Chest Supported Incline Row (Dumbbell).instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight down. Pull the dumbbells up toward your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Lie face down on an incline bench, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down with a slight bend in the elbows.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your ribs, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower the dumbbells back down with control and repeat.

Dead Hang.instructions: Grip a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands roughly shoulder-width apart. Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended, keeping your shoulders relaxed and body still, and hold the position for time.
instruction_steps: Grip a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lift your feet off the floor, allowing your body to hang fully.
Let your arms extend fully, relaxing your shoulders away from your ears.
Keep your core lightly braced to minimize swinging.
Hold the position for the desired time, then release back to the floor.

Gorilla Row (Kettlebell).instructions: Stand over two kettlebells placed shoulder-width apart, hinging at your hips with a flat back. Pull one kettlebell up toward your ribs while keeping the other hand supported on its handle, then lower back down and switch sides.
instruction_steps: Place two kettlebells on the floor, shoulder-width apart.
Hinge at your hips and grip one kettlebell handle while resting the other hand on the second kettlebell.
Keep your back flat and core braced throughout the movement.
Pull the kettlebell up toward your ribs, leading with your elbow.
Lower back down with control and repeat, then switch sides.

Inverted Row.instructions: Set up a bar at waist height or use a suspension trainer. Stand facing the bar or suspension trainer, with your feet shoulder-width apart. Grab the bar or handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Lean back, keeping your body straight and your heels on the ground. Pull your chest towards the bar or handles, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower yourself back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instruction_steps: Set up a bar at waist height or use a suspension trainer.
Stand facing the bar or suspension trainer, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grab the bar or handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lean back, keeping your body straight and your heels on the ground.
Pull your chest towards the bar or handles, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower yourself back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

Iso-Lateral Low Row.instructions: Sit in the iso-lateral row machine with your chest against the pad, gripping the handles independently. Pull the handles back toward your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat and sit with your chest against the pad.
Grip the handles with your arms extended in front of you.
Pull the handles back toward your ribs, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Iso-Lateral Row (Machine).instructions: Sit in the iso-lateral row machine with your chest against the pad, gripping the handles independently at chest height. Pull the handles back toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat and sit with your chest against the pad.
Grip the handles with your arms extended in front of you at chest height.
Pull the handles back toward your torso, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Landmine Row.instructions: Stand over a landmine barbell with feet shoulder-width apart, hinging at your hips with a flat back. Grip the bar just under the sleeve with both hands, pull it up toward your torso, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Stand over the landmine bar, hinging forward at your hips with a flat back.
Grip the bar with both hands just under the collar.
Let the bar hang with your arms extended toward the floor.
Pull the bar up toward your torso, leading with your elbows.
Lower back down with control to the starting position and repeat.

Low Row (Suspension).instructions: Hold the suspension trainer handles and lean back with your body straight and arms extended, feet planted on the floor. Pull your chest up toward the handles by bending your elbows, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then return to the starting position.
instruction_steps: Hold the suspension trainer handles with arms extended in front of you.
Lean back with your body straight, feet planted, and core braced.
Pull your chest up toward the handles by bending your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Return to the starting leaned-back position with control and repeat.

Meadows Rows (Barbell).instructions: Position a barbell in a landmine attachment or corner, standing sideways with a staggered stance. Hinge forward at your hips and grip the bar near the sleeve with one hand, then pull it up toward your hip, leading with your elbow, and lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Set up a barbell in a landmine attachment and stand sideways to it in a staggered stance.
Hinge forward at your hips, keeping your back flat.
Grip the bar near the sleeve with one hand, arm extended toward the floor.
Pull the bar up toward your hip, leading with your elbow.
Lower back down with control and repeat, then switch sides.

Pendlay Row (Barbell).instructions: Set up with a barbell on the floor and hinge forward at your hips until your torso is roughly parallel to the ground. From a dead stop, pull the bar explosively up toward your lower ribs, then lower it back to the floor completely before each rep.
instruction_steps: Stand over the bar with feet hip-width apart and hinge forward until parallel to the floor.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip, arms extended toward the floor.
Pull the bar explosively up toward your lower ribs from a dead stop.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower the bar completely back to the floor and reset before the next rep.

Rack Pull.instructions: Set a barbell on the safety pins of a rack at roughly knee height. Grip the bar with an overhand or mixed grip, then drive through your heels to stand up, extending your hips fully at the top, and lower it back down to the pins with control.
instruction_steps: Set the barbell on the safety pins at roughly knee height inside a rack.
Grip the bar with hands just outside your legs, back flat and chest up.
Drive through your heels, extending your hips and knees to stand up.
Squeeze your glutes and shoulder blades at the top of the movement.
Lower the bar back down to the pins with control and repeat.

Renegade Row (Dumbbell).instructions: Get into a high plank position gripping a dumbbell in each hand, feet spread wider than hip-width for stability. Pull one dumbbell up toward your ribs while balancing on the other arm, then lower it back down and switch sides.
instruction_steps: Get into a high plank position, gripping a dumbbell in each hand.
Spread your feet wider than hip-width for a stable base.
Brace your core to keep your hips level and stable.
Pull one dumbbell up toward your ribs, leading with your elbow.
Lower it back down with control and repeat on the other side.

Scapular Pull Ups.instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and arms fully extended. Without bending your elbows, pull your shoulder blades down and together to raise your body slightly, then release back down to a full hang with control.
instruction_steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms fully extended.
Keep your arms straight throughout the entire movement.
Pull your shoulder blades down and together to raise your body slightly.
Pause briefly at the top of the shrugging motion.
Release back down to a full hang with control and repeat.

Seated Cable Row - Bar Grip.instructions: Sit at a cable row station with your feet braced against the platform, gripping a straight bar attachment with an overhand grip. Pull the bar toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Sit at the machine with feet braced against the platform, knees slightly bent.
Grip the straight bar with an overhand grip and arms extended.
Pull the bar toward your torso, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Seated Cable Row - Bar Wide Grip.instructions: Sit at a cable row station with your feet braced against the platform, gripping a straight bar attachment with a wide overhand grip. Pull the bar toward your upper torso, flaring your elbows out to target your upper back, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Sit at the machine with feet braced against the platform, knees slightly bent.
Grip the straight bar with a wide overhand grip and arms extended.
Pull the bar toward your upper torso, flaring your elbows outward.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Seated Cable Row - V Grip (Cable).instructions: Sit at a cable row station with your feet braced against the platform, gripping a V-bar attachment with palms facing each other. Pull the handle toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Sit at the machine with feet braced against the platform, knees slightly bent.
Grip the V-bar attachment with palms facing each other, arms extended.
Pull the handle toward your torso, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Seated Row (Machine).instructions: Sit in the row machine with your chest against the pad if available, gripping the handles with arms extended. Pull the handles back toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then return to the starting position with control.
instruction_steps: Adjust the seat and grip the handles with your arms extended.
Sit tall, keeping your chest up and back straight.
Pull the handles back toward your torso, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat.

Single Arm Cable Row.instructions: Sit or stand facing a low cable pulley, gripping a single handle attachment with one hand, arm extended. Pull the handle back toward your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blade, then return to the starting position with control before switching arms.
instruction_steps: Attach a single handle to a low pulley and grip it with one hand.
Sit or stand facing the machine with your arm extended toward it.
Pull the handle back toward your ribs, leading with your elbow.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end of the movement.
Return to the starting position with control and repeat, then switch arms.

T Bar Row.instructions: Straddle a T-bar row machine or landmine setup, hinging forward at your hips with a flat back. Grip the handles and pull the weight up toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower back down with control.
instruction_steps: Straddle the T-bar machine, hinging forward at your hips with a flat back.
Grip the handles with your arms extended toward the floor.
Pull the weight up toward your torso, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower back down with control to the starting position and repeat.
